jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
Job Type

Regular

Overview

Information Systems Security functionally manages the process to protect classified information. The Information Systems Security group’s primary function is to implement all classified security policy, procedures and security requirements as required by delegated US Government customers. The Information Systems Security Manager interprets, outlines and enforces classified security policies in accordance with government regulations. This position serves as the subject matter expert for SCI classified systems security processing within the respective RAND Washington office site. The Information Systems Security Manager is required to have excellent leadership skills and be highly self- motivated. This position reports directly to the Manager, Accreditation Services and Corporate ISSM.

Job Duties

Performs as the primary for RAND’s Washington office TS/SCI networks and includes SAP/SAR activities.

Supports the CSSO as duties relate to classified processing for maintaining secure facility accreditations and joint and co-use agreements with applicable government agencies.
Writes, coordinates, and conducts classified systems security education briefings (both SAP and SCI).
Supports the Manager, Accreditation Services in maintaining detailed records of security department functions and activities for monthly reports to RAND management with regard to classified systems; conducts investigations and provides incident reports.
Performs computer systems security activities, implementing security controls for RAND systems processing classified information including initial approval, re-approval, audits and decertification.
Performs duties as follows:

Project Management

Organizes and monitors project timelines to ensure the team achieves milestones and delivers results efficiently.

Task Coordination

Maintains continuous communication with Security management to align priorities and expectations.

Team Member Development

Provides constructive inputs and guidance to foster professional growth and development amongst team members.

Stakeholder Communication

Facilitates clear and effective communication between team members and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and collaboration.
Partners with the Intelligence Agencies and DOW community components regarding inspections, reviews, investigations, and other reportable issues.

Qualifications

In-depth knowledge of Industrial Security and the regulations associated with classified programs, NISPOM, DAAG, ICD's, JSIG and NIST 800 Series documents and applicable government security regulations. Must be familiar with Systems and accreditation processes (RMF) with varying government agencies.
Established relationships and a positive reputation with industrial and government security counterparts along with internal customers.
Have an in-depth understanding of principles and methods used in developing, establishing, and maintaining a federal government compliant program in classified security.
Thorough knowledge of information security systems (SIEM) and proper operations of classified networks.
Currently maintains a DoD 8140 (Cyber Workforce) IAM level 2 certification (CISM, CISSP or Security +).
Proficient in MS Office Applications and Cybersecurity tools.
Excellent written, verbal communication and leadership skills.

Experience

Minimum 8 years' experience in classified systems security required with a BA/BS degree.
In lieu of a BA/BS degree, at least 12 years of experience in classified systems security required.

Education

Minimum requirement of a High School Diploma or GED; BA/BS is preferred.

Location

This position will be in the RAND Washington DC (Arlington VA). This position requires an onsite office presence Monday - Friday.

Security Clearance

Must currently be eligible to hold TS/SCI for access to U.S. government classified information.

Salary Range
: $120,900 - $184,500

RAND considers a variety of factors when formulating an offer, including but not limited to, the specific role and associated responsibilities; a candidate’s work experience, education/training, skills, expertise; and internal equity. The salary range includes base pay plus RAND’s sabbatic pay (which provides additional compensation above base pay when vacation is taken). In addition, RAND provides strong benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, paid time-off and more.

Description

ICF is a mission-driven company filled with people who care deeply about improving the lives of others and making the world a better place. @ ICF Next, we are fearless in finding new ways to solve problems, relentless in making sure it pays off for our clients and committed to making a positive change in the world. 

ICF is seeking an Assistant Project Manager to support scientific research initiatives. Working with the Project Manager or Senior Project Manager, you will lead assigned activities on complex projects, coordinate staff and resources, and serve as a principal liaison for assigned work and other government partners. You will help ensure tasking is completed effectively and on time, resolve technical project issues, and maintain quality control.

Location: This position will be based in Maryland. Must have ability to go into the office in Bethesda, Maryland when required.

Key Responsibilities

Work with the Project Manager or Senior Project Manager to plan and lead assigned activities across complex scientific projects.
Serve as a principal liaison for assigned project activities, communicating with government counterparts and coordinating follow-up across federal agencies, and partner organizations.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestone and deliverable trackers, action item logs, and risk and issue logs; flag delays and dependencies.
Coordinate scientific meetings, working groups, committees, and workshops, including scheduling, agendas, presentation materials, meeting summaries, and action item follow-up.
Prepare and coordinate progress reports, executive briefing materials, presentations, background documents, and other products for government review.
Support funding activities and awardee coordination, as assigned, by tracking milestones, assembling materials, and coordinating with authorized staff.
Collect, organize, and analyze program information to support data calls, landscape analyses, performance reporting, and initiative planning.
Manage assigned technical project issues with scientific and technical staff; recommend solutions, track corrective actions, and escalate unresolved issues to the Project Manager.
Assure quality control for assigned deliverables through accuracy, completeness, consistency, and requirements reviews; maintain organized records and support approved process improvements.

Required Qualifications And Skills

Bachelor’s degree. Relevant fields include scientific disciplines, public health, health sciences, public administration, or project management.
1–2 years of relevant experience in project coordination, project management, or program support in a scientific, biomedical, public health, or related research environment.
Must be a US citizen due to government contract requirements.

Master’s degree (MA or MS). Relevant fields include scientific disciplines, public health, health sciences, public administration, or project management.
Experience supporting project planning, coordinating stakeholders and resources, and tracking schedules, deliverables, and action items.
Understanding of research funding mechanisms and the grants process.
Experience supporting NIH, HHS, or other federal scientific or biomedical research programs, particularly activities involving multiple offices or organizations.
Experience coordinating scientific meetings, committees, working groups, or awardee activities.
Experience with data calls, landscape analyses, program reporting, or scientific communications.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint, and project tracking, dashboard, or data visualization tools.

Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage concurrent assignments and meet deadlines.
Clear, responsive communication and the ability to summarize scientific and project information for different audiences.
Proactive problem-solving and sound judgment about when to resolve issues and when to seek guidance.
Collaborative working style and the ability to adapt to changing priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.
Location: This position will be based in Maryland. Must have ability to go into the office in Bethesda, Maryland when required.

The ideal candidate is a highly collaborative coordinator who excels in fast-paced, high-volume environments, bringing together creative teams, vendors, field leaders, marketing partners, and leadership to drive alignment, maintain brand consistency, and support local marketing execution. You will serve as the operational backbone of campaign and creative delivery, ensuring deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project management for integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, social, and web. Coordinate cross-functional teams including creative, content, social media, digital marketing, analytics, and external agencies.
Build and maintain detailed project timelines, task lists, and production schedules.
Manage development of marketing collateral such as sales materials, brochures, presentations, landing pages, and promotional assets.
Own location creative tickets (e.g., flyers, signage, event materials, local ads, social graphics): clarify needs with the location, set realistic timelines, and deliver within service-level targets.
Prioritize competing location requests; when urgency or capacity conflicts arise, work with the Marketing Business Partner and/or Marketing Director to resolve them and communicate the decision and timeline back to the location.
Own the creative request intake form, defining what locations must provide before work begins, and maintaining routing rules.
Coordinate creative, content, social media, digital, and analytics teams, as well as external agencies and print and production vendors (estimates, proofs, and delivery to locations).
Ensure brand consistency and adherence to marketing standards across all deliverables.
Manage approval workflows, including medical, clinical, or legal review for claims, pricing, and promotions.
Maintain the digital asset library so locations can easily find approved, current materials.
Identify recurring requests and turn them into self-serve templates that reduce custom one-off work.
Facilitate project kickoff meetings, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
Track campaign performance and ticket volume, turnaround, trends, and support post-campaign reporting.
Maintain documentation including briefs, creative requests, and process workflows.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of project management experience within a marketing, advertising, creative services, or agency environment.
Demonstrated experience managing integrated campaigns and creative production, including trafficking, proofing, and approvals.
Experience managing a high-volume creative request or ticket queue against service-level targets.
Strong judgment on brand standards and the ability to guide stakeholders toward on-brand solutions.
Comfortable setting expectations and saying “not yet” to field stakeholders, backed by clear prioritization criteria.
Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana, Smartsheet, Wrike, Jira, Monday.com, or similar programs.
Familiarity with email marketing platforms, social scheduling tools, and digital asset management (DAM) systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present updates to stakeholders and senior leadership.
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or related field.
Agency experience managing multiple brands or clients at once, or experience in a franchise or multi-location organization.
Print production experience and familiarity with brand template platforms (e.g., Canva for Teams, Marq).
Experience in healthcare or veterinary marketing, including regulated or clinical review processes.

About The Role

We are seeking a results-driven Marketing Project Manager to lead web and digital marketing initiatives that help pet owners find, choose, and book with our hospitals. Sitting on the Marketing team, this role manages a portfolio of projects across our network of location websites, including campaign landing pages, site enhancements, local web requests, and digital tool integrations, from intake through launch. The individual will balance company-wide marketing priorities with the needs of individual hospitals so that every location’s web presence drives awareness, trust, and appointments.

Working cross-functionally with Digital Marketing, Web and Technology teams, Marketing Business Partners, external agencies, and location leaders, this individual will serve as a central point of coordination, connecting stakeholders and driving alignment, communication, and accountability throughout the project lifecycle. In addition to managing day-to-day project execution, this role will help improve project intake, prioritization, workflows, and delivery processes to create greater visibility, consistency, and efficiency across the digital project pipeline.

Over time, this role will have the opportunity to help shape agile ways of working within Marketing, including facilitating planning and prioritization in partnership with our Web team. Initially, this may include supporting team planning, coordinating project activities, and gaining experience with agile ceremonies and backlog management, with the opportunity to take on greater facilitation responsibilities as the role and team structure evolve.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience managing cross-functional projects and an aptitude for web and digital technologies. They bring strong communication and relationship-building skills, the ability to navigate competing priorities and connect diverse teams, and a passion for improving how teams collaborate and deliver impactful digital experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Digital Project Management & Delivery

Lead end-to-end project management for website and digital initiatives, including website launches, page templates, site enhancements, campaign landing pages, digital tool integrations, and platform improvements.
Manage projects from initial intake and requirements gathering through planning, execution, quality assurance, launch, and post-launch follow-up.
Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables; proactively identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks to keep projects on track.
Coordinate cross-functional resources and stakeholders across Digital Marketing, Web and Technology, Creative, external agencies, and business teams to ensure alignment and timely delivery.

Gain experience supporting agile team practices, including daily standups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, in collaboration with the Web and Technology teams.
Assist with maintaining project tracking tools, including Jira, to provide visibility into project status, priorities, dependencies, and outstanding work.
Identify opportunities to improve cross-functional collaboration, streamline workflows, and strengthen how digital projects are planned and delivered.
Develop toward greater agile facilitation and Scrum Master responsibilities over time, as team needs and role alignment evolve.

Reporting & Documentation

Track and communicate project status, timelines, milestones, risks, and dependencies to relevant stakeholders.
Monitor and report on digital project and website operational metrics, including request volume, turnaround times, recurring issues, and delivery trends.
Collaborate with appropriate team members to monitor relevant website performance indicators, such as site speed, appointment requests, and other key digital experience metrics.
Maintain project documentation, including requirements, project plans, release notes, process workflows, and supporting resources.
Provide regular updates and escalate project risks, resource constraints, and competing priorities to the appropriate stakeholders.

5+ years of project management experience in in marketing, digital marketing, or an agency environment, with a focus on web projects.

Experience managing a request or ticket queue against service-level targets.

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Experience in veterinary, healthcare, or multi-location service businesses.

IF YOU CARE, THERE’S A PLACE FOR YOU HERE

EFI Global is a full-service engineering, fire investigation, environmental, health and safety, and specialty consulting services firm serving a variety of industries in both the public and private sectors. Over the last four decades, we have grown from a boutique firm specializing in handling insurance fraud and arson cases and providing expert witness testimony, into a recognized global leader in engineering failure analysis, origin-and-cause investigations, environmental consulting, laboratory testing and specialty consulting. Our forensic investigation, engineering and environmental services teams around the world share a dedication to expertise, quality and demonstrating to customers that caring counts®. Each of our more than 700 professional engineers, fire investigators, architects and scientists was selected for their technical proficiency, in-depth industry knowledge and commitment to professional integrity. Together, our diverse backgrounds and collective insights empower clients to make better-informed business decisions. EFI’s combination of global solutions and local expertise has earned the firm a reputation for delivering timely responses that consistently meet our clients’ expectations—anytime, anywhere. Click here to learn more about EFI Global.

PRIMARY PURPOSE
: The Project Manager, EFI coordinates and manages assigned fire investigation and engineering projects, supporting Fire Investigators and Engineers in determining origin, cause, and responsibility. Ensures projects are completed in accordance with client or assigned legal counsel requirements, established budgets, timelines, and company procedures while serving as a primary point of contact for project-related activities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS And RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Planning & Coordination

Coordinate assigned project activities based on established scope, client requirements, timelines, budgets, and company procedures.
Support the assignment and scheduling of investigators, engineers, environmental professionals, and other resources based on availability and project needs.
Maintain project schedules, task lists, and workflow information; follow up on outstanding activities and escalate delays or resource conflicts.
Coordinate approved requests for legal support services, specialty expertise, laboratory services, or other project resources.

Budget & Financial Management

Assist with preparing and maintaining project budgets using established assumptions for travel, lodging, laboratory services, rental vehicles, and other project costs.
Track project activity, deliverables, timelines, and expenses; identify variances and provide timely information to project leadership.
Document approved scope changes and support budget updates and related client communications.
Partner with centralized billing teams to verify project information, review supporting costs, and facilitate accurate invoice preparation and delivery.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Provide routine project status, scheduling, documentation, and budget updates to clients and internal stakeholders within established guidelines.
Collaborate with fire investigators, engineers, environmental professionals, billing partners, and operational leadership to support timely project completion.
Respond to routine project questions and refer technical, contractual, legal, or complex service matters to the appropriate subject matter expert or leader.

Project Administration & Reporting

Coordinate report workflows and delivery, confirming that required documentation is complete and submitted within established timelines.
Perform administrative review of reports for completeness, formatting, and required supporting documentation; route technical content questions to qualified professionals.
Maintain accurate project records, status information, correspondence, and required documentation in company systems.
Prepare routine project tracking reports and summaries for project management and operational leadership.

Client Service and Industry Support

Support client service and business development efforts through professional interactions, responsive project coordination, and participation in approved industry or client events.
Build working knowledge of EFI services, systems, processes, and client expectations.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS And RESPONSIBILITIES

Performs other duties as assigned.
Supports the organization's quality program(s).
Travels as required.

Qualifications

Education & Licensing

High school diploma or GED required. Bachelor's degree in a related major from an accredited college or university preferred, or equivalent experience.

Experience

Two (2) years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience required, including project experience in a team setting; claims administration, forensic consulting, insurance services, fire investigation support, or a related professional services environment.

Skills & Knowledge

Working knowledge of project coordination practices, including scheduling, documentation, task tracking, and budget monitoring.
Ability to organize and prioritize multiple assignments, follow established procedures, and meet deadlines.
Ability to review project information, recognize variances or potential issues, and escalate concerns appropriately.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clients and internal stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn project, billing, and case management systems.
Ability to maintain accurate records and handle confidential or sensitive project information with discretion.
Ability to build productive working relationships and provide responsive service to internal and external clients.
Working knowledge of insurance, forensic, engineering, environmental, or fire investigation environments preferred.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

jobs.description:
Blend is a diverse team of problem solvers who believe that the world’s financial resources should be more accessible. Our cloud banking platform is used by Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, and over 330 other financial services firms to acquire more customers, increase productivity, and deliver end-to-end digital experiences. Our software enables our customers to process an average of more than $5 billion in loans per day, making it possible for consumers to reach their financial goals faster and lead better lives. Come do work that matters.

Senior Project Manager, Client Activation

Location: Remote (US)

Type: Full-time
Level: IC4
Reports to: Vice President, Client & Revenue Operations

About The Role

Blend's software powers mortgage, home equity, and consumer banking for many of the largest banks, credit unions, and lenders in the US. Client Activation is the team that takes a signed customer to a live, working product.

You will own the delivery of our most complex customer engagements: Rapid home lending implementations and dedicated engineering PODs that build alongside our largest customers. You run the plan, the dates, the risks, and the governance, working with our Professional Services Consultants, who own the solution, and with Engineering and Product.

It is a senior individual contributor seat. There are no direct reports. We are hiring judgment, structure and follow-through, and someone who already works AI-first.

What you will do

Own three to four concurrent customer engagements end to end, from kickoff through go-live, hypercare, and close.
Build and maintain the integrated project plan: milestones, dependencies across Blend and the customer, resourcing, and critical path.
Run governance: weekly status, SteerCo with customer executives, a live RAID log, and decision records.
Run the agile rhythm on dedicated POD engagements: sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, velocity and burn-up reporting, and alignment of sprint output to SOW milestones.
Take over projects that are off track: rebuild the plan, set dates the team can hit, clear blockers, and drive escalations to resolution.
Manage scope: assess change requests, show their impact on date and effort, and route commercial changes to Deal Desk.
Work with Product and Engineering to get go-live blockers prioritized and resolved.
Keep TaskRay accurate on every project you own: health, dates, EAC, and weekly status.
Use AI as a core part of the job: status drafting, plan analysis and risk spotting, and help us design the next tools for Client Activation.
Help set the project management standard for Client Activation: templates, governance, and lessons learned that others use.

What you bring

Seven or more years managing customer-facing implementations of enterprise SaaS, with several projects running at once.
Experience delivering for banks, credit unions, mortgage lenders, or other regulated financial institutions.
Agile delivery experience alongside engineering teams: sprints, velocity, release planning, and backlog governance.
A record of recovering projects that were off track, with specifics on what you changed.
Executive presence: you run SteerCos, deliver bad news early with options, and hold your ground on scope.
Strong command of plans, dependencies, RAID, and change control, in a PSA tool such as TaskRay, Salesforce, Asana, or similar.
AI-first working habits. You already use AI tools to do real work faster, can show us how, and know where to check their output.

Nice to have

PMP, PMI-ACP, or a similar certification.
Mortgage, home equity, or loan origination domain knowledge.
Experience with TaskRay on Salesforce.
Experience with dedicated development team or co-build engagements governed by a SOW.
Hands-on experience building internal automations or AI workflows.

Why you might want this role

Ownership of the engagements that matter most to our customers and to Blend, with a direct line to the Vice President, Client & Revenue Operations.
Clear, visible impact: projects that go live on time.
A new function you help shape, with AI-first tooling already in place.

Compensation

Base salary range: $125,000 to $150,000. This applies to full-time hires. Final offer determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to function, level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
Bonus: Eligibility is contingent upon both company performance against established goals and achievement of individual performance objectives.
Equity: Restricted Stock Units in public company stock (NYSE: BLND), so you share in Blend's long-term growth.

Our Benefits At a Glance

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health and work-life balance.

Health & Wellbeing

We offer medical, dental, and vision benefits, with a generous employer contribution that helps keep your medical insurance costs low.
Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability coverage
Generous PTO, holidays, and maternity/parental leave
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): mental health, legal, childcare & eldercare, financial planning, college search, and more
Voluntary benefits: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, identity theft, and legal insurance
Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, mental health, and well-being
Additional perks: Milk Stork, pet insurance, and paid volunteer time off

Growth & Future

401(k) retirement plan with company match
Pre-tax savings: healthcare & dependent care FSAs, Limited Purpose FSA, and HSA

Manage deliverables, schedules, service levels, and testing coverage, anticipating delivery risks and capacity constraints to drive mitigation plans.
Team Leadership: Lead, coordinate, and coach a team of Localization Quality Account Managers (LQAMs) across assigned workstreams. Set expectations for roles, work allocation, and communication standards while balancing capacity to ensure continuity during periods of change or shifting priorities.
Governance and Reporting: Establish and manage the operating cadence, including delivery reviews, stakeholder updates, and executive governance. Stakeholder and Partner Management: Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and coordinate cross-functional internal teams (including Account Management, Testing Services, Community Operations, and Product). Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world, every day. We’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

We are seeking a Security Technical Program Manager (Security TPM) to help operate and scale the programs that protect Snap’s data, systems, identities, and customer experience.

This role serves as a portfolio-level program leader across Access and Privacy Engineering. You will turn ambiguous privacy and security priorities into clear operating models, roadmaps, controls, execution plans, and measurable outcomes. You will partner with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, Legal, Compliance, Security, and business teams to make the right work visible, actionable, and sustainable.

The role supports the full lifecycle of privacy and security risk: identifying signals, establishing ownership, defining requirements, prioritizing work, driving adoption, validating outcomes, and communicating decisions and residual risk to leadership

What you’ll do

Own the cross-functional privacy and data governance, translating strategy into priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans.
Build operating mechanisms for intake, prioritization, decision-making, escalation, dependency management, exceptions, and closure.
Drive privacy-by-design programs that define data use, retention, access, sharing, minimization, and control requirements early in the lifecycle.
Coordinate material reviews and clarify technical feasibility, required approvals, controls, decision rights, and ownership.
Lead complex, company-wide programs through rollout, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
Provide leadership visibility, resolve blockers, and automate program workflows where appropriate.

Strong understanding of privacy engineering, data governance, information security, and risk management.
Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in privacy engineering, data governance, security, data, infrastructure, or platform environments.
Ability to connect technical and control requirements to business outcomes, customer experience, operational risk, and regulatory obligations.
Experience building operating models, governance mechanisms, roadmaps, metrics, decision frameworks, and leadership reporting in ambiguous domains.
Strong technical judgment, including the ability to evaluate trade-offs, clarify approval requirements, and distinguish facts, decisions, dependencies, and residual risk.
Track record of driving adoption of platforms, standards, controls, and processes across teams with varied incentives and maturity.
Excellent written and verbal communication, organization, prioritization, facilitation, and follow-through across long-running programs.
Collaborative leader who builds trust, resolves conflict, facilitates decisions, and mentors program managers.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
6+ years of experience in technical program management in the privacy engineering, compliance, risk management, or technical solution delivery domains
Demonstrated experience leading privacy engineering programs across multiple engineering or business organizations.
Demonstrated experience converting ambiguous requirements or risk signals into measurable execution plans and outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with privacy-by-design, data lifecycle governance, data classification, data inventories, data access, retention, deletion, or third-party data risk
Experience with GDPR, CCPA, NIST Privacy Framework, ISO 42001, NIST 2.0, ISO 27001, or comparable frameworks.

Job Overview

The Senior Project Manager, Public Sector is a strategic execution partner to the Senior Director, Public Sector Success. This individual contributor leads high-priority initiatives that advance Relativity’s government strategy, and supports the Senior Director directly with strategic planning, executive preparation, and cross-functional follow-through. The role translates segment priorities into clear, executable plans; guides complex work across Success, Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Security, Legal, GRC, Finance, and partners; and provides decision-ready visibility to senior leaders.

The work spans government accreditation and platform readiness (such as FedRAMP High, GovRAMP, and DoD impact levels), customer and market intelligence, government requirements intake, segment operating rhythms, and customer programs and events. The role works closely with the Programs and Operations team, Practice Empowerment, Customer Engagement, and Adoption Services, and with Sales and Product counterparts. Success is measured by predictable delivery, strong cross-functional alignment, better and faster executive decisions, and measurable customer and business outcomes in the public sector.

Job Description And Requirements

Strategic support and leadership partnership

Serve as a thought partner to the Senior Director on segment strategy, annual and quarterly planning, goals and KPIs, resourcing and headcount cases, and business cases for government growth investments.
Prepare briefing materials, strategy memos, and decision papers for executive reviews, the Product Leadership Team, the monthly Strategy and Operating Review, and quarterly segment reviews, with clear options and recommendations.
Track commitments, decisions, and open asks across the Senior Director’s priorities; anticipate what needs attention next and keep leaders and partner teams moving on follow-through.
Represent Public Sector Success in cross-functional forums when appropriate, and carry government priorities into the planning cycles of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Success Operations.

Government accreditation, platform readiness, and compliance programs

Support integrated planning for government security and accreditation programs, including FedRAMP High, GovRAMP for state and local customers, and DoD impact levels (IL4, IL5, IL6), in partnership with GRC, Product, Engineering, and Programs and Operations. GRC owns scoping and control decisions, and Product owns roadmap and release decisions.
Coordinate readiness for RelativityaiR Government releases and feature parity, including government-specific dependencies, data sovereignty and data handling requirements, Public Trust and personnel requirements, and customer communications.
Plan and track account-level migration and end-of-life efforts for government customers, including Server migration planning and defined positions on higher-impact-level requirements.
Build and maintain the government security and compliance roadmap view, with milestones, dependencies, risks, and decision points that Sales, Success, and Product can use with customers.

Customer, contract, and market intelligence

Build customer intelligence and account mapping for government accounts, including agency and component structure, mission use cases, stakeholders, contract vehicles, and expansion potential, to inform CSM account plans and stakeholder maps.
Maintain contract-lifecycle intelligence, including option years, recompete and renewal calendars, task orders, and procurement vehicles, so account teams can plan engagement ahead of key dates.
Track the competitive landscape, agency AI and eDiscovery initiatives, solicitations, RFIs, and policy developments (including federal and state AI governance), and translate findings into practical recommendations for Success, Sales, Product, and Marketing.
Use adoption and usage data, including aiR adoption by account and FOIA time to go-live, to monitor customer health, identify risks and opportunities, and recommend course corrections.

Government Requirements And Product Input

Own the intake and triage process for government requirements, feature gaps, and customer escalations, with clear owners, status, and feedback loops back to customers.
Work with Practice Empowerment and Product to turn customer evidence, agency workflows, and adoption data into prioritized roadmap input and readiness plans.

Growth, capture, and partner initiatives

Support the government growth plan with Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships, including account and agency targeting, coordinated pursuit planning, and tracking of agreed targets for accounts won and expanded and aiR adoption.
Coordinate cross-functional inputs for strategic pursuits, sources-sought responses, and RFIs, including requirements mapping, past performance, and reusable response content, working with capture and bid resources as they are established.
Support partner programs that serve government customers, including partner-delivered and partner-hosted accounts, joint account plans, escalation paths, and partner readiness, in coordination with the Gov Partnership Success workstream.

Segment operating rhythm and customer programs

Run the operating rhythm for the Public Sector Success team, including the risk and handoff register, support register, scorecard and KPI reporting, planning calendars, and cadences shared with Account Services and Success Operations.
Plan and deliver customer-facing programs and events, such as the Public Sector Forum, agency roundtables, speaking engagements, and customer executive sessions, with Marketing and the account teams.
Help design and roll out repeatable engagement standards, playbooks, and onboarding approaches for government agencies, including FOIA and aiR adoption, with Customer Engagement and Adoption Services.

Project management practice

Translate strategic goals into project charters, integrated plans, milestones, ownership models, resource needs, success measures, and operating rhythms.
Anticipate and manage risks, issues, scope changes, and interdependencies; develop mitigation plans and escalate decision points with clear options and recommendations.
Establish fit-for-purpose governance, documentation, and change-management approaches that support adoption, auditability, and repeatable execution in regulated public sector environments.
Improve project management practices, templates, dashboards, and lessons-learned processes; coach contributors and promote consistent execution standards.
Coordinate external vendors or partners when applicable, ensuring deliverables, timelines, risks, and contractual expectations remain aligned.
Travel for customer engagements, agency visits, planning sessions, and company or customer events, generally up to 15%.

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of project or program management experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from definition through implementation and measurement; equivalent experience considered.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous strategic priorities into structured plans, governance, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Experience supporting senior leaders directly, including preparing executive briefings, strategic plans, or business cases.
Experience influencing senior stakeholders and coordinating work across multiple functions without direct authority.
Experience managing scope, schedules, resources, risks, dependencies, change, and executive communications across concurrent initiatives.
Experience working in SaaS, technology, professional services, government, legal technology, or another regulated environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise materials for technical, business, and executive audiences.
Working knowledge of project management methods and tools such as Jira, Asana, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Confluence, PowerPoint, or equivalent platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting U.S. federal, state, local, or other public sector customers, including government procurement, security, compliance, records, investigations, or FOIA and public records workflows.
Familiarity with government security and accreditation frameworks such as FedRAMP, GovRAMP, NIST 800-53, or DoD impact levels, or experience coordinating security, compliance, or accreditation programs.
Familiarity with the government contract lifecycle, including contract vehicles, task orders, option years, recompetes, RFIs, and proposal or capture support.
Experience with customer, market, or competitive intelligence, or with building account plans and stakeholder maps.
Experience with eDiscovery, legal data intelligence, RelativityaiR, RelativityaiR Government, customer adoption, or enterprise-scale change initiatives.
Interest in or exposure to AI governance, responsible AI, and AI adoption in government settings.
PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, Certified ScrumMaster, or comparable project or change management certification.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

$140,000 and $210,000

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Budget Management, Communication, Mentorship, Process Improvements, Program Management, Project Management, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Team Leadership, Vendor Management

jobs.description:

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About The Role

Join MiniMed in a role where you will help connect employees to the business, bring strategy to life, and shape how key messages are understood across the organization. As Corporate Communications Program Manager, you'll partner with leaders to drive impactful internal communications, from all-hands meetings and functional updates to organizational changes and transition communications that keep teams informed, engaged, and aligned. This is an opportunity to combine strategic thinking with impactful storytelling while helping advance the mission of improving lives through innovative diabetes technology. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy turning complex information into meaningful employee experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

Directly manages communications activities that promote, enhance, and protect the organization's reputation to both internal and external audiences.
Advances the company narrative to media and other external audiences as defined, which may involve the strategic conceptualization and execution of creative (PR) campaigns.
Handles the creation and implementation of multiple forms of internal strategic communication activities, programs and content guided by the Medtronic Mission and overall business strategy.
Oversees and executes the writing, editing and approval of event scripts, speeches, key documents and reports, promotional materials, press releases, interviews, FAQs and other external and internal communications vehicles as defined.
Supports senior leadership in communicating to external and internal audiences.

Must Have Minimum Qualifications

To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident on your resume.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in marketing program management, communications, or healthcare-related programs.

OR

Advanced Degree in Marketing, Communications, Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field, and 5+ years of experience in marketing program management, communications, or healthcare-related programs.

Nice to Have

Demonstrated experience in corporate communications, public relations and media relations, preferably within the medical technology, medical device, diagnostics or healthcare technology industries.
Experience in diabetes technology or related therapeutic areas is highly desirable.
Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, clinical and business information into clear, compelling communications.
Experience developing and executing proactive media relations strategies and building relationships with journalists and other external stakeholders.
Experience supporting executive communications, thought leadership, product launches and strategic corporate initiatives.
Experience working in a publicly traded company and collaborating across complex, cross-functional organizations is preferred.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: RUHS Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
For questions regarding this position, please contact the Recruiter listed in the Supplemental Information section.

About The Position

Riverside University Health System (RUHS) seeks candidates for an RUHS Compliance Program Manager position. This role supports the development, coordination, implementation, and oversight of RUHS corporate compliance programs and activities. The selected candidate will supervise support staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations, and perform related duties as required. Current certification in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC)
is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities Include

Supporting compliance with federal, state, and county laws and regulations, including HITECH.
Providing subject matter expertise on medical privacy and information security.
Overseeing staff and managing program activities as assigned.
Assisting in achieving compliance goals and strategic objectives.

The RUHS Compliance Program Manager is a journey-level manager classification reporting to the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer. Incumbents are expected to perform complex and increasingly responsible work with minimal supervision, contributing to the design, execution, and monitoring of effective compliance programs. This position is distinct from the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer, which entails broader responsibilities in directing and managing regulatory compliance programs.

This class has been deemed eligible for the Performance Recognition Plan as set forth under Article 3, Section 311(C) of the County Management Resolution. Program eligibility requires employees to be in a leadership position, manage other employees or programs, and have significant influence on the achievement of organizational objectives.

Why RUHS Medical Center?

Riverside University Health System-Medical Center is nationally recognized for its innovative, progressive care and is considered one of the top employers in the region. The 439-bed Medical Center is a designated Stroke Center, Level I Trauma Center, and home to the only Pediatric ICU in the area.

For more information about RUHS Medical Center, please visit ruhealth.org .

Examples Of Essential Duties

Perform audits to assess compliance with various laws, regulations, policies, and standards such as those related to healthcare fraud, waste and abuse, billing and coding, clinical documentation, privacy and information security, research and ethics; maintain a system of reporting that provides timely and relevant information of all aspects of compliance issues.
Participate in appropriate level of response, develop corrective action plans and conduct compliance investigations while maintaining confidentiality of information reported, as appropriate.
Evaluate departmental continuous readiness to achieve compliance in the areas of healthcare privacy and security; assist in the development and implementation of privacy policies, procedures and breach notification as necessary.
Develop and implement policies and procedures for filing and investigation of complaints related to HIPAA/HITECH Privacy, Breach Notification Rules and related County guidelines and procedures.
Develop and monitor policies and procedures that establish standards for ensuring patient privacy protections, including by providing guidance to individual employees and departments on the HIPAA Privacy Rule, as appropriate.
Document and retain all complaints received as required by HIPAA/HITECH; establish and maintain a mechanism for tracking and reporting the investigation and resolving such complaints.
Develop and administer training for RUHS staff to promote awareness of compliance to regulatory standards.
Provide guidance and assistance to departments on a variety of privacy and compliance auditing, and internal control matters; document findings and prepare reports.
Supervise, assign, review, and evaluate the work performed by staff; direct the day-to-day operations of support staff.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree, preferably with a major in business administration, public administration, public health nursing, finance, accounting, or a closely related field to the assignment. (A master's degree from an accredited college or university in any of the aforementioned majors is preferred.) Possession of current Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC) certification is preferred.

Experience:
Three years of professional, journey-level experience in healthcare compliance, which includes internal auditing experience and experience in the development and implementation of HIPAA and/or privacy compliance programs.

Knowledge of:
Information security; theory, principles and practices of general healthcare; governmental accounting, budgeting and auditing; HIPAA privacy and security rules and regulations; privacy laws, rules and regulations relating to information and security; federal, state and local codes, rules and regulations including healthcare fiscal operations; the methods of developing systems forms for various types of accounting records and reports; information systems and their application to accounting operations; the principles, methods and techniques of public administration, personnel and business office management; the principles and techniques of supervision.

Ability to:
Develop and implement compliance and auditing programs; apply legal and administrative compliance policies to hospital or health systems; analyze data, draw logical conclusions, conduct independent audits, reviews, and make evaluations to ensure compliance issues and concerns are appropriately evaluated, investigated and resolved; recommend effective courses of action; communicate effectively in oral and written form; establish and maintain effective working relationships; conduct independent systems analyses of complex business processes.

SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION

Recruiter Contact Information

Angela Levinson/951-955-5562/alevinson@rivco.org

________________________________________________________________________________________

APPLICATION INFORMATION

Veteran's Preference

The County has a Veterans Preference Policy applicable to new hires. To qualify, attach the required documents to your job application. Documents include a copy of your (or your spouse's) Member-4 Form DD-214 indicating dates of service. For spousal preference, and as applicable, the following documents: a copy of your marriage certificate, spouse's death certificate, a letter of spouse's disability and/or letter of service-related death (if available) from the U.S. Veteran's Administration. For privacy reasons, it is recommended that you remove your social security information from the document(s). A Human Resources Representative will review the materials and determine if you qualify for veterans' preference. For complete details and documentation requirements, please review the Veterans Preference Policy, C-3 here: https://rivcocob.org/board-policies

Reasonable Accommodations

The County of Riverside is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants as required by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA). Qualified individuals with disabilities who need a reasonable accommodation during the application or selection process should contact the recruiter for the position noted above. For additional information and/or to obtain the appropriate form for requesting a reasonable accommodation, please visit the Disability Access Office web page located at: https://rc-hr.com/disability

Schedule, Overtime, Standby/On-Call, and Travel Obligations

The County of Riverside offers a variety of alternative work schedules, dependent upon department operations and needs. Certain assignments may involve overtime, standby/on-call shifts, and/or travel; however, scheduling, shift assignments, overtime work, standby/on-call duty, and travel obligations are subject to management approval, operational needs, and/or may be modified or discontinued at any time. Applicants should contact the assigned recruiter for additional information regarding the schedule, overtime and standby/on-call expectations, and travel obligations.

Proof of Education

If using education to qualify or when requested by the recruiter, upload a copy of any license(s), official/unofficial transcript(s), degrees, and/or related employment documents to your NeoGov account at the time of application and before the closing date. Official or unofficial transcripts will be accepted.

If your education was completed outside of the United States, you will need to provide a copy of your Foreign Education Equivalency evaluation from a member of the National Association of Credential Evaluation Services ( NACES ) or Association of International Credential Evaluators, Inc. ( AICE ).

Work Authorization Requirement

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. The County of Riverside does not participate in visa sponsorship programs, including H1-B visas, and will not provide sponsorship for any employment-based visas.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The County of Riverside is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of the County of Riverside to provide equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, ancestry, medical condition (cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, or denial of medical and family care leave, or any other non-job-related factors.

Pre-Employment

All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of pre-employment requirements including a criminal background investigation, which involves fingerprinting. (A felony or misdemeanor conviction may disqualify the applicant from County employment). A pre-employment physical examination and background check may be required.

Probationary Period

As an Approved Local Merit System, all County of Riverside employees, except those serving "At Will," are subject to the probationary period provisions as specified in the applicable Memorandum of Understanding, County Resolution, or Salary Ordinance. Temporary and Per Diem employees serve at the pleasure of the agency/department head.

General Information

Current County of Riverside and/or current employees of the hiring department may receive priority consideration. Qualified candidates may be considered for future County vacancies.

Job postings may close without notice based on application volume. Submit your complete application by the recruitment close date; no late applications are accepted. Ensure all relevant experience/education is reflected on your application/resume, as a failure to demonstrate position requirements may disqualify applicants. A description of job duties directly copied from the job classification or job posting will not be considered.

Please read and follow any special application instructions on this posting. Click the ' Apply
' link located on this page to submit your application. For additional instructions on the application process, examinations, Veteran's preference, pre-employment accommodation or other employment questions, please refer to our web site, www.rc-hr.com .

If you are experiencing technical problems, you may contact the governmentjobs.com applicant support desk Monday through Friday, 6 am to 5 pm Pacific Time at support@governmentjobs.com or toll-free 1-855-524-5627.

jobs.title: Physical Security Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.

The Physical Security Manager, assigned to a specific client, will oversee day-to-day physical security operations, risk assessments, and contract security performance for assigned U.S. remote sites while driving continuous improvement through incident analysis, program reviews, and corrective-action tracking. The Manager leads the planning and execution of security technology and facility improvement projects, coordinating closely with Global Security leadership, site stakeholders, cross-functional teams, contract security providers, project teams, and business units to execute security initiatives, improve site-level operational effectiveness, and maintain consistent security practices across assigned locations. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned sites, ensuring responsive, customer-focused security support across operational, project, and incident-related needs.

Responsibilities

Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
Manage day-to-day physical security operations for assigned U.S. remote sites in accordance with Global Security standards, policies, procedures, and service expectations, including implementation and ongoing execution of programs that safeguard personnel, visitors, contractors, facilities, IP, critical assets, and operations.
Conduct site-level security assessments of controls, processes, staffing, and technology; document findings, gaps, and emerging risks; recommend mitigations and enhancements based on risk, threat conditions, and site needs; and track corrective actions through closure, providing leadership visibility into outstanding items.
Oversee contract security providers, monitoring staffing compliance, training completion, post order adherence, service quality, and issue escalation.

jobs.title: Stage - Data Analyst (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran.AI - De l'IA qui opère dans le réel

Filiale de Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran.AI conçoit des solutions d'IA appliquées à des données complexes telles que les images satellite haute résolution, les flux vidéo FMV et les signaux acoustiques. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des algorithmes capables de détecter et d'identifier automatiquement des objets d'intérêt dans les secteurs du renseignement, de la défense et de l'aéronautique.

Depuis son intégration à Safran en septembre 2024, Safran.AI contribue également à la transformation du groupe, en appliquant les solutions d’IA aux domaines de l’industrie 4.0. À titre d’exemple, l’analyse d’images automatisée par l’IA peut assister les contrôleurs en charge de l’inspection de pièces critiques en les aidant à détecter les anomalies éventuelles à partir de clichés numériques.

Fort de nos 250 collaborateurs, vous évoluerez au sein d’équipes passionnées et pluridisciplinaires, réunissant des talents parmi les plus reconnus du secteur, tous animés par une même exigence d’excellence et d’innovation technologique.

Brève introduction de l'équipe

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe AI Platform, qui développe une plateforme data (datalake, datawarehouse, orchestrateur de transformation de données, BI) et un ensemble d’outils internes de MLOps à destination des data scientists visant à accélérer le développement et la mise en production de modèles de machine/deep learning : l’AI Factory.

Toutes les étapes de développement sont couvertes : captation de la donnée, ingestion, transformation, modélisation et exposition. Nos enjeux sont nombreux pour stocker une grande quantité de données et l’exposer de la manière la plus efficace aux data scientists.

Nous sommes une quinzaine de collaborateurs au sein de l’équipe, avec des profils mixtes AI / Data Engineering / Software.

Descriptif des missions

En tant que Data Analyst en stage au sein de l’équipe AI Platform, vous contribuerez à développer les usages analytics de notre plateforme de données. En vous appuyant sur les briques existantes, notamment notre datalake et nos data warehouses, vous explorerez les données pour en tirer des enseignements utiles aux équipes et favoriser une prise de décision basée sur la donnée.

Avec l’accompagnement de l’équipe, vous travaillerez notamment à :

échanger avec les équipes AI Platform et les data scientists au sein des différents domaines d’application pour comprendre leurs besoins, identifier des cas d’usage et les traduire en questions d’analyse et en indicateurs pertinents
explorer les données disponibles dans le datalake, les data warehouses et les outils existants, afin d’en comprendre le contenu, la qualité et le potentiel pour les analyses identifiées
préparer, croiser et analyser ces données, notamment à l’aide de SQL et de Python, pour identifier des tendances, des points d’attention et des pistes d’amélioration
définir et construire des indicateurs et des tableaux de bord, par exemple avec Metabase, pour suivre les usages et les performances des produits de la plateforme
partager les résultats de vos analyses avec les équipes concernées, en expliquant leurs limites et en proposant des pistes d’action
contribuer à la fiabilité et à la réutilisation des analyses en documentant les sources, les définitions des indicateurs et les méthodes employées, en lien avec les data engineers

Notre stack technique

Nous utilisons essentiellement du Python orchestré avec Airflow, des bases de données PostgreSQL (extension PostGIS) ainsi que des services AWS (S3, EC2, RDS..). Nous manipulons des formes hétérogènes de données (rasters, vidéos, fichiers parquet, GeoJSON, …), exploitées à l’aide de notre datalake (utilisation d’Iceberg et de Kafka par exemple).

Nos applications data sont déployées sur un cluster Nomad (Hashicorp), avec une intégration et un déploiement continu depuis Github Actions.

Nos collègues SRE utilisent quant à eux principalement les technos Ansible, Terraform pour l’automatisation et la suite Prometheus / Grafana pour le monitoring. La plupart de nos applications sont déployées sur le cloud et on-premise.

Votre profil

En formation Bac+4/5 en informatique, data, statistiques ou dans un domaine connexe, vous avez envie d’explorer des données et d’en tirer des enseignements concrets pour aider les équipes à prendre des décisions.

Compétences techniques attendues :

Vous avez déjà manipulé et analysé des données dans le cadre de projets académiques, personnels ou de stages
Vous connaissez SQL et savez interroger des bases de données relationnelles pour sélectionner, joindre et agréger des données
Vous avez des bases en Python pour préparer et analyser des données, par exemple avec les bibliothèques pandas ou équivalentes
Vous connaissez les principes de base de l’analyse statistique et savez porter un regard critique sur la qualité des données et les résultats obtenus
Vous avez une première approche de la visualisation de données et de la construction d’indicateurs ou de tableaux de bord

Une première expérience avec un outil de BI ou de visualisation, comme Metabase, et une connaissance des environnements datalake ou data warehouse sont des plus, sans être indispensables.

Qualités humaines recherchées :

Curiosité, rigueur et envie d’apprendre dans un environnement technique et pluridisciplinaire
Capacité à échanger avec différents interlocuteurs pour comprendre leurs besoins et restituer clairement les résultats d’une analyse
Esprit d’initiative et goût pour le travail en équipe

Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, n’hésitez pas à postuler si vous pensez pouvoir apporter votre énergie et votre regard à notre équipe !

Ce que vous trouverez chez Safran.AI

Safran.AI réuni des sujets techniques de fond, des équipes qui maîtrisent leur domaine et une culture où la rigueur et l'entraide coexistent.

Structure à taille humaine adossée à un groupe industriel de premier plan, elle permet de travailler sur des enjeux réels sans renoncer à la proximité.

Nos bénéfices d’entreprise

🍽️ Carte Swile de 11 € / jour travaillé pris en charge par SAFRAN AI à hauteur de 59,1%

🚆 Jusqu’à 75 % des frais de transport pris en charge ou forfait mobilité durable

🧘 Avantages bien-être : Moka Care, conférences & accès sport via Wellpass

Votre parcours de recrutement

Un échange de 30 minutes avec un recruteur pour en apprendre plus sur vous, vos attentes et vous donner plus de détails sur la vie chez Safran.AI 
Un échange d'une heure avec votre futur tuteur de stages et une personne de l'équipe afin de vous permettre dès le début de rencontrer vos futurs collègues et de rentrer dans la technique de votre métier ! Lors de cet échange, vous serez amené à présenter un projet spécifique que vous avez pu mener !

Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Overview

Are you looking for a highly rewarding opportunity that provides extensive career growth opportunity? Gilbane is seeking a Project Manager I
to be responsible for supporting the Senior Project Manager and/or Project Manager II in the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome of a construction project, or serving in the lead role over a small project. This position will be on the job site every day and will fill a key role on the project team.

Who are we?

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You will have the opportunity to build schools, labs, hospitals, corporate offices, sports arenas and more!

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who are you?

You are a coach/leader who leads with an inclusive and empathetic mindset. You provide feedback and guidance to help others excel in their current or future roles. You determine priorities, delegate work, and effectively communicate progress. You establish measures to assess the impact, quality, and timeliness of results while praising successes and sharing lessons learned. You build high performing teams by attracting, engaging, developing, and retaining talented individuals through motivation and discipline to maximize impact on the organization and the individual.

You leverage business insights by understanding industry trends, local market/economic conditions, and Gilbane’s business model to make critical decisions and create competitive advantage. You deploy a strategic mindset when considering solutions to long-term opportunities and risks that may develop in the future.

Your core values match Gilbane’s: Integrity, Caring, Teamwork, Toughmindedness, Dedication to Excellence, Discipline, Loyalty, and Entrepreneurship.

What’s in it for you?

Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to the project, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you will work with experienced Sr. Project Managers and Project Executives on each job site which provides you with opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

Responsibilities

Assists in preparation and administration of the project safety plan
Assists in project controls and procedures, and manages established risk mitigation processes
Creates and follows through on potential change items and participates in verification of project financial forecast
Creates and manages a project-specific quality plan aligned with the owner contract and contract documents and assists with execution
Creates and manages a closeout plan in alignment with the contract documents and assist with execution
Directs and supervises work of project administration, project superintendents, and engineers to establish operational priorities
Assists in subcontracting strategy, supports scope writing and deliverables to ensure the integrity of the buyout process
Implements and enforces all aspects of contracts; participates in developing risk mitigation plan; prepares draft contracts, agreements, and purchase orders
Participates in enrollment for insurance and bonds; tracks and obtains trade contractors’ compliance
Provides support as needed to develop project estimate, design coordination efforts, and preparation of GMP
Prepares monthly schedule updates, including schedule analysis, and narratives for select packages
Assists constructability and coordination reviews
Develops a basic understanding of the local market areas and profiles to assist in creation of networking strategy
Trains direct reports on processes, procedures, and completion of daily tasks
Manages workload and performance of direct reports, ensuring alignment with overall company standards
Fosters a positive and inclusive work environment to motivate and engage team members
Aids in communicating company and department strategy to direct reports

Experience/Education

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management
4-7 years of experience
Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong technical and communication skills are critical
Ability to work in a team environment
Knowledge of industry standard software, Microsoft Office (preferred)

Salary to be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience of the applicant, as well as the internal equity and alignment with the team.

For San Jose, CA this ranges from $119,800-$164,700 plus benefits and retirement program.

Gilbane offers an excellent total compensation package which includes competitive health and welfare benefits and a generous profit-sharing/401k plan. Synaptics is leading the charge in AI at the Edge, bringing AI closer to end users and transforming how we engage with intelligent connected devices, whether at home, at work, or on the move. As the go-to partner for the world’s most forward-thinking product innovators, Synaptics powers the future with its cutting-edge Synaptics Astra™ AI-Native embedded compute, Veros™ wireless connectivity, and multimodal sensing solutions. We’re making the digital experience smarter, faster, more intuitive, secure, and seamless. From touch, display, and biometrics to AI-driven wireless connectivity, video, vision, audio, speech, and security processing, Synaptics is the force behind the next generation of technology enhancing how we live, work, and play.

Overview

Synaptics is looking for an Individual Contributor Principal Program Manager, equivalent to a Director-level role, to join our Video Interface and Human Presence Detection team. You will be responsible for managing programs in SW/FW and ASIC domains making sure the engineering teams stay productive and focused on creating the greatest value for the business. This position reports to the Sr. Director, Program Management.

The typical base pay range for this position is USD $185,000 - $291,500 per year. Individual pay is determined by many factors including work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This position is also eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus, equity, and other benefits. Note that compensation listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Responsibilities & Competencies

Job Duties

Own end-to-end program management of engineering programs from idea to mass production including planning, scoping, design, development, and change management
Lead, track, and monitor cross-functional projects rallying teams around short-term and mid-term deliverables while maintaining the long-term plan
Plan and track execution of programs lasting anywhere from 6mo-2yrs (depending on project) with focus on interdisciplinary deliverables
Support the teams in issue resolution and risk mitigation through well balanced and efficient processes leveraging tools and automation
Champion an efficient, disciplined approach to planning, tracking, requirements gathering, change management and risk management with the use of tools and analytics
Actively support sustainable, effective cross-functional communication at multiple levels in the organization
Analyze technical issues and lead the team in generating creative mitigation options and solutions
Report status of program execution with focus on schedule, risks, and issues utilizing data-based models and indicators
Drive continuous improvement of all processes, methodologies, and systems

Competencies

Well organized with strong attention to data and detail; proactively ensures work is accurate
Demonstrated ability to grasp new technical concepts quickly
Ability to ask difficult but important questions and drive discussion to find answers
Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations
Proactive, self-starter, able to work independently in a fast-paced environment with a strong sense of urgency, ownership and accountability
A highly structured planner with a strong discipline towards pragmatic and efficient processes
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in agile execution and facilitating multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to synthesize and report complex matters simply for senior and executive management to grasp quickly
Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work within a diverse team

Qualifications (Requirements)

Bachelors (Master’s preferred) degree in Computer Science or Electronics or related field, or equivalent
15+ years of experience in SW and/or IC program/project management
Experience in rigorous life-cycle management including capturing requirements, decomposition, architecture, design, unit testing and integration testing among others
Proven expertise in planning tools and methodologies (jira, MS Project / SCRUM, waterfall)
Hands-on technical experience preferred
25% domestic and international travel is required
