About the Role

AppGate Professional Services is looking for a customer-focused Customer Delivery Project Manager to lead the implementation of our Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) platform for US commercial customers. As the primary customer-facing lead for medium to large engagements, typically two to six months long, you will own delivery from project handover through production go-live and transition to Support and Customer Success.
This is a delivery leadership role, not a sales or account management position. You will manage scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, and expectations across structured, milestone-driven projects, working alongside AppGate engineers so they can stay focused on architecture, configuration, and customer enablement. Professional Services operates as a P&L, so this role directly influences project profitability, revenue realization, and services margin. Success is measured by on-time milestone delivery, customer satisfaction at go-live and close-out, project financial performance, and clean handover to Support with complete close-out documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Customer and Stakeholder Management

•Serve as the primary AppGate point of contact for US commercial customers throughout service delivery, managing day-to-day requests and communication.
•Build strong working relationships with customer IT and security teams, project sponsors, and executive stakeholders.
•Lead status calls, milestone reviews, and stakeholder briefings so all parties have a clear, accurate view of progress, risks, and decisions required.
•Manage expectations proactively, addressing scope, timeline, and deliverable questions before they become escalations.
•Translate customer requests into actionable delivery tasks, assess feasibility, flag out-of-scope requests, and route them to the right internal resource.
•Escalate risks and customer concerns early, with a clear recommendation.

Delivery Execution

•Manage multiple concurrent ZTNA implementations across US commercial customers.
•Own service delivery end to end: scope, schedule, budget, milestones, deliverables, and resource coordination.
•Maintain delivery documentation throughout each engagement, including project plans, status reports, risk logs, and go-live and close-out records.
•Coordinate AppGate delivery engineers on each project, ensuring clear task ownership and removing blockers.
•Run change control for all out-of-scope requests: prepare change requests and SOW amendments for commercial approval in Salesforce, and ensure no work proceeds without approved authorization and documentation.

Financial Accountability (P&L)

•Own the financial health of assigned projects, including hours burned against contracted hours, utilization, and billing accuracy.
•Identify revenue, margin, and schedule risk early; flag burn-rate deviations and propose corrective action before budget is exceeded.
•Drive timely milestone completion and customer sign-off to support accurate billing and revenue realization.
•Protect services margin by preventing unbilled scope: no out-of-scope work proceeds without an approved change order.

Delivery Quality and Governance

•Apply AppGate's global delivery methodology consistently across engagements.
•Keep engagements aligned to each customer's security posture, network segmentation, identity, and compliance objectives, not just go-live.
•Contribute to delivery documentation standards and templates used across the commercial book of business.
•Identify resource constraints and delivery bottlenecks, and propose solutions.
•Provide regular delivery and financial reporting to the RVP, Customer Solutions.

Internal Contribution

•Contribute to commercial capacity planning and resource forecasting.
•Support pre-sales by reviewing SOW drafts, validating scope and delivery feasibility, and flagging delivery risk before commitments are made. This role does not commit scope, timelines, or pricing to customers.

Required Qualifications

•5+ years of experience as a customer-facing project or delivery manager, including at least 3 years on cybersecurity or networking engagements.
•Experience managing complex B2B technology implementations.
•Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, and stakeholder expectations across structured, milestone-driven commercial IT or security projects.
•Experience managing project financials in a services P&L environment, including budgets, burn rate, utilization, and billing.
•Working knowledge of network segmentation, identity, and access control concepts sufficient to manage delivery without engineering translation.
•Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce and present delivery documentation to a professional standard.
•Ability to challenge customers and internal teams constructively when necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

•PMP, PRINCE2, or an equivalent project management credential. Proven delivery experience matters more than the credential.
•Experience delivering identity and access management (IAM), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), or enterprise security platform deployments.

Travel

Occasional customer travel as project delivery requires.

The IT Project Manager is a member of the Agile Delivery & Project Management team within the Digital Services Team (DST). The role reports to the Manager, Agile Delivery. The IT Project Manager leads multiple concurrent technology projects across the Enterprise Data Platform, Data & Analytics, master data, mobile and field-service enablement, operational reporting, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities.

Working with business leaders, Steering Committees, technical teams and external vendors, the IT Project Manager is accountable for delivering projects that achieve their intended business outcomes. All work is completed in accordance with the DST PMO project management model, governance standards, and controlled templates.

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability

Own end-to-end project delivery—from kickoff through go-live—ensuring alignment with business outcomes and DST PMO best practices.
Work with sponsors and business stakeholders to define scope, measurable success criteria, baselines and expected benefits. Track benefit realization after go-live.
Build and maintain integrated project plans that reflect dependencies, critical paths and named resource allocations. Re-forecast proactively and transparently when conditions change.
Negotiate resource allocations, manage shared and constrained teams, and bring trade-offs and sequencing decisions to leadership with clear options.
Coordinate SOWs and hold partners accountable to their commitments.
Maintain project governance, including RAID registers, decision logs, weekly Project Status Updates and Steering Committee reporting. Apply the governance profile appropriate to project size and risk.
Own budgets, forecasts, and variance reporting.
Escalate risks and issues early to sponsors and Steering Committees, with a clear statement of impact and a recommended course of action.
Engage Architecture Review, Financial Controls/ITGC and Audit/SOX requirements early where applicable.
Partner with business and change leads on training, communication and readiness activities to support adoption.
Apply Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate, keeping governance proportionate to project size and risk.
Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO practices, templates and lessons learned.

Qualifications/Requirements

Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Business or a related field.
5+ years of experience managing IT projects end to end, including multiple concurrent projects across business and technical teams.
Demonstrated success delivering projects with shared resources, competing priorities and vendor dependencies.
Experience managing third-party vendors and offshore or nearshore partners.
Strong working knowledge of project governance, including stage gates, RAID management, decision logs, Steering Committee reporting and financial tracking.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present status, risks and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
Sound judgment in prioritization, escalation and re-planning, with strong follow-through to closure.
Working knowledge of Agile and traditional delivery methodologies.
Proficiency with Planview (or a comparable portfolio management tool), Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Excel and Microsoft 365/Teams.

Assets

Experience delivering data and analytics projects, such as data platforms, master data management, Power BI or reporting tools, and cloud data services.
Experience with ERP, manufacturing, service or mobile/field-enablement solutions.
Exposure to AI or automation initiatives.
Experience applying Audit/SOX, ITGC or data governance controls within project delivery.
Project management certification, such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM/PSM or equivalent.

The team partners with business and product leaders to drive B-Stock’s strategy, identify opportunities for growth and investment, and drive innovation and best-in-class execution across teams. You'll also raise how the team works by applying AI to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis, building toward more automated approaches to recurring strategy and operations work over time. This person would report directly to the Vice President of Strategy & Business Operations.

B-Stock is an office-first company. You will be expected to work on-site three days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday at one of our office in Boston, MA, with Monday and Friday remaining non-office days where you may perform your duties remotely from your residence. We believe having consistent time together helps teams stay connected to the work happening across the business, collaborate in real time, and move ideas and decisions forward more effectively.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Drive end-to-end strategic projects to define and accelerate the company’s top growth priorities
Lead B-Stock’s foray into new segments, offerings, or partnerships leveraging the depth of B-Stock’s data, customer relationships, and network
Develop strategic frameworks to identify market growth opportunities for B-Stock
Help business leaders and executives make smart decisions and drive them to implementation by bringing data, analysis, and industry expertise to bear.
Identify and implement AI-enabled workflows and automations within Strategy & Business Operations to compress analysis cycles and scale the team's output
Design and run the operating cadence — planning cycles, business reviews, and cross-functional execution — turning strategy into delivered outcomes, not just recommendations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

5+ years in a strategy, consulting, finance, or business-operations role where you personally drove problems from hypothesis to delivered result
You're highly analytical and quantitatively fluent — you bring rigor to decisions and structure ambiguous problems, model in spreadsheets, pressure-test assumptions, and quantify the size of the prize.
You have a bias to impact — you've owned initiatives from strategy through execution and can point to outcomes you shipped
You communicate with clarity and influence — distilling complex analysis into simple, actionable recommendations that help executives make fast, confident decisions
Hands-on experience applying AI tools within analytical or operating workflows to build automations or multi-step processes, and comfort quickly adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge
You have a learning mindset and adapt quickly - we learn new things every day

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Two-sided marketplace, Retail, Logistics and/or Supply Chain experience
Interest in or exposure to reverse logistics, returns, or the circular economy
Experience taking a new product, segment, or initiative from 0-to-1
MBA or advanced degree from a top program, or equivalent experience

The pay rate for this role will range between $110,000 to $150,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options
Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K)
Support for continuing education
Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple
Snacks, drinks, and the occasional box of donuts

THE COMPANY

B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. With hundreds of thousands transactions completed annually, B-Stock gives buyers a simple and direct way to buy valuable products directly from retailers and offers sellers a technology-driven replacement for traditional resale methods, while boosting operational efficiency, recovery rates, and cycle time.

Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come.

For more information, visit bstock.com/careers/

OUR VALUES

Make Each Dollar Count

Whether it’s the recovery amount or a buyer’s budget, money matters to all of our clients. And because each dollar matters to them, it matters to us.

Take Our Work Seriously, Not Ourselves

Everything at B-Stock continues to grow - everything but our egos, that is. We’re not afraid to let loose and laugh (often at ourselves).

Do The Hard Things Today That Will Pay Off Tomorrow

We’re willing to sacrifice and endure, fail and adapt to reach our long-term goals.

Use Trust As The Best Measure Of Success

The trust we earn along the way is more valuable than money. Without trust from both our buyers and sellers, our business won’t succeed.

Find Strength In Numbers

Use our passion for data to provide value to our customers, improve ourselves, and develop new ways to delight our buyers and sellers.

Seeking an experienced Supply Chain Sr. Project Manager to lead complex cross-functional projects involving the setup of a new manufacturing facility and its related procurement and logistics functions.
Responsible for planning, leading, and executing IT and business-led implementations within Intuitive Business Applications.
Requires strong supply chain domain knowledge across Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver, with expertise in manufacturing operations and SAP implementation projects.
Lead projects involving new-site implementations, product launches, system upgrades, facility expansions, and manufacturing process improvements.
Drive project management best practices, integrated timelines, governance, and successful delivery across Global Operations.

Responsibilities:

Plan, coordinate, and execute IT and business COE-led implementations involving procurement, manufacturing, and delivery functions for a new manufacturing plant. Manage projects ranging from ideation and solution evaluation to implementation at new sites, product launch scale-ups, system upgrades, and facility expansions.
Develop, coordinate, and maintain integrated Manufacturing and Product Qualification timelines and governance for all assigned project activities. Drive project execution, manage schedules, assign tasks, and ensure alignment across business and technical teams.
Gain cross-functional alignment on strategies, goals, resources, and timelines across Finance, Manufacturing & Operations, Infrastructure, Product Quality, Regulatory & Compliance, Field Service, and other business units. Partner with business PMs to organize and lead core team meetings and executive steering committee meetings, including status reporting to project sponsors and stakeholders.
Manage project plans, budgets, actuals, resources, risks, issues, constraints, conflicts, and critical paths. Drive timely resolution of challenges that may impact successful project execution and communicate project status, risks, and progress to stakeholders.
Manage the quality and delivery of project deliverables, including kickoff presentations, detailed project schedules using MS Project/Smartsheet, project budget vs. actuals, business blueprints, test plans, and training plans. Drive organizational change management activities, including stakeholder analysis, communication plans, training materials, end-user training, and solution adoption. Ensure compliance with internal business and quality system requirements and external regulatory standards.

Required Qualifications:

8–10 years of experience working across business and IT, with a minimum of 8 years leading major cross-functional projects in Manufacturing Operations. Strong project delivery experience in SAP Lead roles as Project Manager, Delivery Manager, or COE Technical Lead.
Mandatory PMP certification. Scrum Master (CSM) certification is also desirable. Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
Strong SAP Supply Chain Project Management experience, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC 6.0 multi-module ERP implementations. Must have experience with SAP S/4HANA projects and phased global implementations across multinational industries.
Demonstrated experience leading technical project teams using Agile methodologies and managing end-to-end SAP implementations. At least two successful end-to-end ECC 6.0/S/4HANA implementations in mid-size industries and one implementation in a large manufacturing industry will be a distinguishing factor.
Strong supply chain domain knowledge across Plan, Source, Make, and Deliver, including procurement, manufacturing, and logistics functions.
Experience managing third-party system integrators, SAP Services, and other external service providers during project implementation.
Knowledge of SAP ME (MES System), SAP S/4 EWM, TMS, and Agile (PLM) is beneficial. Experience implementing MES systems is a plus.
Proficiency in MS Office, JIRA, MS Project, and Smartsheet, with strong communication, presentation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence and work effectively across all organizational levels, manage ambiguity, and oversee multiple projects simultaneously.
Medical device industry experience and people supervision experience are desirable.

jobs.title: Customer Success Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
About Checkr

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About The Team/role

As a Customer Success Implementation Manager reporting to the Director of Implementations, you will drive successful deployments for Checkr’s most important customers and partners. You will contribute to the day-to-day project management of multiple deployments at once, keeping scope, timelines, and quality on track. You will partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architects, Product, Support, and Customer Success Managers to deliver a white-glove onboarding experience that supports Checkr’s growth.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain project plans and RAID logs from templates, and lead regular check-in meetings with customers and partners
Identify project risks early and coordinate with the right teams to mitigate and resolve them
Track and report deployment progress to management using reporting tools and dashboards
Manage dependencies across GTM, Product, and Operations for multiple concurrent projects
Prepare and coordinate customer training, helping customers and partners understand product features and benefits
Translate complex project information for audiences ranging from project-level contributors to executives, and hand off customers smoothly to Customer Success Managers after go-live
Serve as a go-to subject matter expert on product functionality
Collaborate as a team player, sharing knowledge and supporting teammates

What You Bring

3+ years of project management experience in a related industry or SaaS
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, and comfort communicating from executives to analysts
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence collaborative decision-making
Technical understanding of software systems at scale, including high-level knowledge of APIs
Flexibility to manage multiple priorities and projects, internal and external, in a fast-paced environment
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes

Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website .

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)

$151,000—$178,000 USD

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (Denver, CO)

$128,000—$151,000 USD

What We Offer

A fast-paced and collaborative environment
Learning and development allowance
Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services
Flexible PTO policy
Monthly wellness stipend

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr

Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance .

Applicant Privacy Policy

If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process.

For applicants in Massachusetts:
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Legitimate Checkr emails will always include our official domain name after the @ symbol (e.g., name@checkr.com or name@ext.checkr.com).

jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

Join Zoom's Security Operations Centre team in India, where your work directly shapes how we detect, respond to, and recover from threats across a complex, global technology environment. You'll operate at the intersection of SIEM engineering, incident response, and threat hunting, bringing analytical rigor to ambiguous situations and building the detection capabilities that keep Zoom secure. At this level, you're expected to lead investigations from triage through resolution, collaborate across cloud, identity, and product security disciplines, and continuously improve the processes and tooling that power our SOC. If you're energized by fast-moving threat landscapes and thrive in a team that values both depth of expertise and open collaboration, this role offers real scope to grow and make an impact.

About The Team

Our SOC India team sits at the heart of Zoom's global security operations, working alongside detection engineering, IT, cloud security, and product security teams to protect a platform trusted by hundreds of millions of people worldwide. The team covers the full spectrum of security events, from phishing and identity threats to cloud misconfigurations and product security incidents, operating with a follow-the-sun model. We value clear thinking, rigorous documentation, and a shared commitment to continuously strengthening Zoom's security posture.

Responsibilities

Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across SIEM, EDR, email security, identity, and cloud platforms using CrowdStrike NGSIEM, Splunk, and related tooling.
Lead incident response from initial triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
Partner with the Incident Response team to address security incidents and provide timely support.
Work proactively with Cyber Threat Intelligence to gather actionable intelligence and respond effectively to incidents.
Collaborate closely with the Detection Engineering team to develop new detection and reduce false positives.
Create, tune, and manage detection rules and alerts in CrowdStrike NGSIEM and Splunk, reducing false positives and maintaining clear documentation of logic and coverage.
Apply AI tools to accelerate incident analysis, summarize investigations, and support detection development, validating all outputs before acting on them.
Investigate phishing and email threats using Proofpoint, and analyze suspicious files and URLs through sandbox platforms such as Joe Sandbox.
Investigate identity-based threats and suspicious authentication activity in Okta, and analyze cloud security events across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI to identify misconfigurations and attacker behavior.
Handle PSIRT cases related to product security, coordinating with engineering and cross-functional teams to assess impact and track remediation.
Read and interpret PowerShell and Python scripts, and apply scripting and automation to streamline investigation, enrichment, and reporting workflows.
Document incidents, detections, and playbooks to a standard that supports handover, audits, and continuous improvement, and contribute to shift handovers, metrics reporting, and SOC process improvements.

What We're Looking For

3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in SOC operations, incident response, or threat hunting.
Practical experience with CrowdStrike NGSIEM (Falcon Next-Gen SIEM) and CrowdStrike EDR, including detection rule development, alert tuning, and host-level investigation.
Proficiency with Splunk SIEM, including writing searches, building alerts, and supporting detection engineering workflows.
Experience investigating email threats with Proofpoint Email Security and analyzing suspicious files and URLs using sandbox environments such as Joe Sandbox.
Hands-on experience with at least two cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI) from a security monitoring perspective, and experience investigating identity-based threats in Okta logs.
Working knowledge of PowerShell and Python for security scripting and automation, with a strong understanding of attacker techniques mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM
is seeking an experienced Bridge Inspection Project Manager
to help develop and grow our bridge inspection capabilities within our Construction Management team in Texas. This is an exciting opportunity for an established bridge inspection professional to take a leadership role in positioning AECOM for future bridge inspection, assessment, and preservation opportunities throughout Texas and surrounding states. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with project management, client relationship development, and business development capabilities to help expand AECOM's presence in this specialized area of transportation infrastructure.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead and support a variety of anticipated inspection programs, potentially including routine and complex bridge inspections, tunnel inspections, and underwater bridge inspection assignments. You will bring technical knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods, fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, and specialized inspection procedures. As opportunities develop, you may also oversee underwater inspection activities, including coordinating inspection divers, planning inspection operations, and ensuring appropriate technical and safety protocols are followed.

Beyond technical delivery, this position offers the opportunity to help establish and grow AECOM's bridge inspection team in Texas and surrounding states. Initially managing a small group of inspection and technical professionals, you will help identify future staffing needs, recruit and develop additional talent, and build the capabilities necessary to support anticipated business growth. You will engage with TxDOT and other state DOTs, municipalities, and transportation clients, serving as a technical resource while identifying opportunities to strengthen existing relationships and develop new business. This may include partnering with other engineering consultancies, supporting strategic pursuits, participating in marketing initiatives, and representing AECOM at industry conferences, trade shows, and professional events.

This is an opportunity for a technically accomplished bridge inspection professional who enjoys being involved in the field, developing people, building client relationships, and helping grow a business. You will have the support and resources of AECOM's established transportation and construction management organization while helping shape the future direction of its bridge inspection capabilities across the region.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and support routine and complex NBIS bridge inspection programs as opportunities develop, ensuring inspections are performed in accordance with applicable federal requirements, state DOT standards, and client expectations.
Provide technical leadership for specialized inspection opportunities, potentially including fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, underwater bridge inspections, tunnel inspections, and other complex structural assessments.
Plan and coordinate potential underwater bridge inspection assignments, including overseeing inspection divers, developing inspection plans, coordinating field resources, and ensuring appropriate safety procedures and technical requirements are followed.
Provide technical oversight of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and specialized inspection procedures used to evaluate structural conditions, identify deterioration, and assess the integrity of bridge components.
Support bridge condition assessments and preservation efforts, evaluating inspection findings, identifying critical deficiencies, managing Follow-Up Actions (FUAs), and developing recommendations for maintenance, rehabilitation, and repair.
Manage project budgets, schedules, staffing, subcontractors, deliverables, and quality control activities for awarded bridge inspection and assessment projects.
Serve as a primary client contact as projects develop, building relationships with TxDOT, other state DOTs, municipalities, and transportation agencies while communicating technical findings, project progress, and recommended solutions.
Review and oversee the preparation of bridge inspection reports, condition assessments, technical evaluations, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable NBIS and agency requirements.
Initially manage a small team of bridge inspection professionals, with the opportunity to recruit, develop, and expand the team as business needs and project opportunities increase.
Identify and pursue opportunities to expand AECOM's bridge inspection services through client engagement, relationship development, strategic marketing, and participation in transportation infrastructure pursuits.
Develop teaming relationships and partner with other engineering consultancies and industry firms to pursue potential inspection and preservation opportunities and strengthen AECOM's position in the regional bridge inspection market.
Represent AECOM at industry conferences, technical meetings, trade shows, and professional association events, helping promote the firm's bridge inspection capabilities and develop new client relationships.
Maintain a strong commitment to safety, ensuring field personnel follow established safety protocols, applicable OSHA standards, proper equipment setup procedures, and safe working practices during inspection activities.
Travel throughout Texas and surrounding states to support inspection programs, client meetings, business development activities, and project assignments, including overnight travel as opportunities require.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

BA/BS + 8 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of Texas or the ability to obtain Texas PE licensure through reciprocity.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience managing routine and complex NBIS bridge inspection programs, including hands-on experience with fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, procedures, and specialized structural assessments.
TxDOT Precertification 6.1.1 – Bridge Inspection Team Leader, along with completion of the NHI Safety Inspection of In-Service Bridges national training course.
Additional TxDOT pre-certifications, including 6.1.2, 6.2.1, 6.2.2, 6.3.1, 6.3.2, 6.4.1, 6.5.1, 6.5.2, 6.6.1, and 6.6.2.
Experience with underwater bridge inspection programs, including planning inspection operations, overseeing inspection divers, coordinating specialized equipment, and ensuring compliance with applicable safety and inspection requirements. Rope access training and certifications, including SPRAT, are a plus.
Demonstrated experience with tunnel inspections, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods, bridge condition assessments, and preservation programs, including identifying deterioration, managing critical findings and Follow-Up Actions (FUAs), and recommending appropriate repair and rehabilitation strategies.
Experience working directly with TxDOT and other state DOTs, transportation agencies, and municipal clients, with the ability to develop client relationships, communicate complex technical findings, and support the development of long-term inspection programs.
Proven experience building and managing technical teams, including recruiting, mentoring, developing staff, and expanding inspection capabilities. Experience with movable bridge inspections and assessments is highly desirable.
Demonstrated business development and marketing experience, including developing client relationships, partnering with other engineering consultancies, supporting proposals and strategic pursuits, and representing an organization at industry conferences, trade shows, and professional events.

Additional Information

This role does not provide Visa Sponsorship

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $135000 to $180000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Description

Cybersecurity Analyst – Risk and Compliance

SAIC is seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst to support a critical U.S. government agency in the National Capital Region. This junior to mid-
level role focuses on preparing risk acceptance proposals, analyzing security issues and proposing resolutions, conducting security risk assessments, and ensuring compliance with federal cybersecurity requirements. The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge and the ability to communicate complex risks to senior stakeholders and Authorizing Officials.

This is a great opportunity for a cybersecurity professional with hands-on experience in NIST-based compliance, risk analysis, and continuous monitoring, particularly those interested in supporting security governance, risk acceptance, and the broader Risk Management Framework (RMF) lifecycle. The analyst will work closely with Information System Security & Privacy Officers (ISSPOs), system owners, and IT stakeholders to evaluate and manage cybersecurity risks across a diverse technology environment.

Responsibilities

Develop and evaluate risk acceptance proposals, including business justifications, mitigation strategies, and residual risk documentation for approval by Authorizing Officials.
Conduct Security Impact Analyses (SIAs) for proposed technical changes, external connections, or public-facing applications, identifying affected NIST controls.
Support remediation of identified vulnerabilities and propose resolution paths.
Support the development and validation of security control implementation statements based on NIST SP 800-53 and agency-specific policies.
Identify and document control deficiencies, contributing to the creation and tracking of POA&Ms.
Support Continuous Monitoring efforts by reviewing system changes and verifying alignment with SSPs and security baselines.
Update system security documentation, including system boundary diagrams, architecture descriptions, and SSPs after major updates.
Assist in the creation, revision, and enforcement of security policies and technical guidance in collaboration with SMEs.
Participate in IT governance processes, including security waivers, standards reviews, and exception handling.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that system and network configurations align with compliance and security requirements.
Contribute to briefings, status reports, and planning documents in support of overall project and security lifecycle management.

Qualifications

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of cybersecurity experience, or Master’s degree and 5+ years of experience.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with technical security controls and risk assessments in federal IT environments.
Strong knowledge of the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and related cybersecurity standards.
Experience performing risk assessments and impact analyses using NIST guidance.
Understanding of IT infrastructure components including networking, Windows, Linux/Unix, and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure).
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical writing skills.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain risk and compliance matters to technical and non-technical audiences.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

Preferred Qualifications

Current certification such as CISSP, CISM, or Security+.
Experience using GRC tools (e.g., JCAM, eMASS) to track security documentation and compliance activities.
Familiarity with continuous monitoring processes and tools in a federal environment.
Knowledge of FedRAMP, cloud compliance, and federal privacy requirements.

Clearance Requirement

All candidates must be eligible to obtain a U.S. Public Trust clearance.

**This hybrid role requires a minimum of three on-site days per week in Washington, DC.**

Target salary range $60,001 - $100,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

Overview

Information Systems Security functionally manages the process to protect classified information. The Information Systems Security group’s primary function is to implement all classified security policy, procedures and security requirements as required by delegated US Government customers. The Information Systems Security Manager interprets, outlines and enforces classified security policies in accordance with government regulations. This position serves as the subject matter expert for SCI classified systems security processing within the respective RAND Washington office site. The Information Systems Security Manager is required to have excellent leadership skills and be highly self- motivated. This position reports directly to the Manager, Accreditation Services and Corporate ISSM.

Job Duties

Performs as the primary for RAND’s Washington office TS/SCI networks and includes SAP/SAR activities.

Supports the CSSO as duties relate to classified processing for maintaining secure facility accreditations and joint and co-use agreements with applicable government agencies.
Writes, coordinates, and conducts classified systems security education briefings (both SAP and SCI).
Supports the Manager, Accreditation Services in maintaining detailed records of security department functions and activities for monthly reports to RAND management with regard to classified systems; conducts investigations and provides incident reports.
Performs computer systems security activities, implementing security controls for RAND systems processing classified information including initial approval, re-approval, audits and decertification.
Performs duties as follows:

Project Management

Organizes and monitors project timelines to ensure the team achieves milestones and delivers results efficiently.

Task Coordination

Maintains continuous communication with Security management to align priorities and expectations.

Team Member Development

Provides constructive inputs and guidance to foster professional growth and development amongst team members.

Stakeholder Communication

Facilitates clear and effective communication between team members and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and collaboration.
Partners with the Intelligence Agencies and DOW community components regarding inspections, reviews, investigations, and other reportable issues.

Qualifications

In-depth knowledge of Industrial Security and the regulations associated with classified programs, NISPOM, DAAG, ICD's, JSIG and NIST 800 Series documents and applicable government security regulations. Must be familiar with Systems and accreditation processes (RMF) with varying government agencies.
Established relationships and a positive reputation with industrial and government security counterparts along with internal customers.
Have an in-depth understanding of principles and methods used in developing, establishing, and maintaining a federal government compliant program in classified security.
Thorough knowledge of information security systems (SIEM) and proper operations of classified networks.
Currently maintains a DoD 8140 (Cyber Workforce) IAM level 2 certification (CISM, CISSP or Security +).
Proficient in MS Office Applications and Cybersecurity tools.
Excellent written, verbal communication and leadership skills.

Experience

Minimum 8 years' experience in classified systems security required with a BA/BS degree.

Minimum requirement of a High School Diploma or GED; BA/BS is preferred.

This position will be in the RAND Washington DC (Arlington VA). This position requires an onsite office presence Monday - Friday.

Prepare briefing materials, strategy memos, and decision papers for executive reviews, the Product Leadership Team, the monthly Strategy and Operating Review, and quarterly segment reviews, with clear options and recommendations.

Track the competitive landscape, agency AI and eDiscovery initiatives, solicitations, RFIs, and policy developments (including federal and state AI governance), and translate findings into practical recommendations for Success, Sales, Product, and Marketing.
Use adoption and usage data, including aiR adoption by account and FOIA time to go-live, to monitor customer health, identify risks and opportunities, and recommend course corrections.

Work with Practice Empowerment and Product to turn customer evidence, agency workflows, and adoption data into prioritized roadmap input and readiness plans.

Translate strategic goals into project charters, integrated plans, milestones, ownership models, resource needs, success measures, and operating rhythms.
Anticipate and manage risks, issues, scope changes, and interdependencies; develop mitigation plans and escalate decision points with clear options and recommendations.

Experience working in SaaS, technology, professional services, government, legal technology, or another regulated environment.

new_jobs.description:

About The Position

Riverside University Health System (RUHS) seeks candidates for an RUHS Compliance Program Manager position. This role supports the development, coordination, implementation, and oversight of RUHS corporate compliance programs and activities. The selected candidate will supervise support staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations, and perform related duties as required. Current certification in Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC)
is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities Include

Supporting compliance with federal, state, and county laws and regulations, including HITECH.
Providing subject matter expertise on medical privacy and information security.
Overseeing staff and managing program activities as assigned.
Assisting in achieving compliance goals and strategic objectives.

The RUHS Compliance Program Manager is a journey-level manager classification reporting to the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer. Incumbents are expected to perform complex and increasingly responsible work with minimal supervision, contributing to the design, execution, and monitoring of effective compliance programs. This position is distinct from the RUHS/County Compliance and Privacy Officer, which entails broader responsibilities in directing and managing regulatory compliance programs.

This class has been deemed eligible for the Performance Recognition Plan as set forth under Article 3, Section 311(C) of the County Management Resolution. Program eligibility requires employees to be in a leadership position, manage other employees or programs, and have significant influence on the achievement of organizational objectives.

Why RUHS Medical Center?

Riverside University Health System-Medical Center is nationally recognized for its innovative, progressive care and is considered one of the top employers in the region. The 439-bed Medical Center is a designated Stroke Center, Level I Trauma Center, and home to the only Pediatric ICU in the area.

For more information about RUHS Medical Center, please visit ruhealth.org .

Examples Of Essential Duties

Perform audits to assess compliance with various laws, regulations, policies, and standards such as those related to healthcare fraud, waste and abuse, billing and coding, clinical documentation, privacy and information security, research and ethics; maintain a system of reporting that provides timely and relevant information of all aspects of compliance issues.
Participate in appropriate level of response, develop corrective action plans and conduct compliance investigations while maintaining confidentiality of information reported, as appropriate.
Evaluate departmental continuous readiness to achieve compliance in the areas of healthcare privacy and security; assist in the development and implementation of privacy policies, procedures and breach notification as necessary.
Develop and implement policies and procedures for filing and investigation of complaints related to HIPAA/HITECH Privacy, Breach Notification Rules and related County guidelines and procedures.
Develop and monitor policies and procedures that establish standards for ensuring patient privacy protections, including by providing guidance to individual employees and departments on the HIPAA Privacy Rule, as appropriate.
Document and retain all complaints received as required by HIPAA/HITECH; establish and maintain a mechanism for tracking and reporting the investigation and resolving such complaints.
Develop and administer training for RUHS staff to promote awareness of compliance to regulatory standards.
Provide guidance and assistance to departments on a variety of privacy and compliance auditing, and internal control matters; document findings and prepare reports.
Supervise, assign, review, and evaluate the work performed by staff; direct the day-to-day operations of support staff.

Minimum Qualifications

Education:
Graduation from an accredited college or university with a bachelor's degree, preferably with a major in business administration, public administration, public health nursing, finance, accounting, or a closely related field to the assignment. (A master's degree from an accredited college or university in any of the aforementioned majors is preferred.) Possession of current Healthcare Privacy Compliance (CHPC) certification is preferred.

Experience:
Three years of professional, journey-level experience in healthcare compliance, which includes internal auditing experience and experience in the development and implementation of HIPAA and/or privacy compliance programs.

Knowledge of:
Information security; theory, principles and practices of general healthcare; governmental accounting, budgeting and auditing; HIPAA privacy and security rules and regulations; privacy laws, rules and regulations relating to information and security; federal, state and local codes, rules and regulations including healthcare fiscal operations; the methods of developing systems forms for various types of accounting records and reports; information systems and their application to accounting operations; the principles, methods and techniques of public administration, personnel and business office management; the principles and techniques of supervision.

Ability to:
Develop and implement compliance and auditing programs; apply legal and administrative compliance policies to hospital or health systems; analyze data, draw logical conclusions, conduct independent audits, reviews, and make evaluations to ensure compliance issues and concerns are appropriately evaluated, investigated and resolved; recommend effective courses of action; communicate effectively in oral and written form; establish and maintain effective working relationships; conduct independent systems analyses of complex business processes.

Certain assignments may involve overtime, standby/on-call shifts, and/or travel; however, scheduling, shift assignments, overtime work, standby/on-call duty, and travel obligations are subject to management approval, operational needs, and/or may be modified or discontinued at any time. Overview

170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.
At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.

The Physical Security Manager, assigned to a specific client, will oversee day-to-day physical security operations, risk assessments, and contract security performance for assigned U.S. remote sites while driving continuous improvement through incident analysis, program reviews, and corrective-action tracking. The Manager leads the planning and execution of security technology and facility improvement projects, coordinating closely with Global Security leadership, site stakeholders, cross-functional teams, contract security providers, project teams, and business units to execute security initiatives, improve site-level operational effectiveness, and maintain consistent security practices across assigned locations. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned sites, ensuring responsive, customer-focused security support across operational, project, and incident-related needs.

Responsibilities

Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
Manage day-to-day physical security operations for assigned U.S. remote sites in accordance with Global Security standards, policies, procedures, and service expectations, including implementation and ongoing execution of programs that safeguard personnel, visitors, contractors, facilities, IP, critical assets, and operations.
Conduct site-level security assessments of controls, processes, staffing, and technology; document findings, gaps, and emerging risks; recommend mitigations and enhancements based on risk, threat conditions, and site needs; and track corrective actions through closure, providing leadership visibility into outstanding items.
Oversee contract security providers, monitoring staffing compliance, training completion, post order adherence, service quality, and issue escalation.
Monitor and report on program and system performance through operational reviews, incident trends, stakeholder feedback, and KPIs including covering incidents, contract security performance, technology health, project execution, and corrective-action status, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
Support incident management through intake, escalation, reporting, after-action reviews, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking for assigned sites.
Ensure significant risks, incidents, service issues, and control deficiencies are escalated to Global Security leadership as appropriate.
Support security-related change management in response to evolving business requirements, threat conditions, site needs, and operational priorities.
Plan, coordinate, and execute physical security projects including technology deployments, facility enhancements, capital improvements, site remediation.
Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, resource requirements, risk registers, action trackers, and performance metrics, and reporting status/milestones/dependencies to leadership.
Coordinate cross-functionally across Global Security, Facilities, IT, HR, Legal, EHS, vendors, business units, and site leadership to deliver projects and security solutions within schedule, budget, and quality expectations, and to meet enterprise standards and program objectives.
Serve as the primary security point of contact for assigned sites, building and maintaining relationships with site leaders and stakeholders, maintaining regular engagement to understand operational needs and concerns, promoting a customer-focused approach to service delivery and issue resolution, and facilitating communication across regional and global teams.
Escalate matters requiring policy interpretation, strategic direction, or broader organizational decisions to Global Security leadership.
Provide operational oversight of physical security technologies and support the implementation, optimization, and lifecycle management of physical security technologies, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, visitor management, alarm monitoring, and related systems.
Partner with security technology teams, IT, and vendors to resolve system issues and address operational/business requirements, monitoring and reporting on technology-related issues, system health, and service requests.
All other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, security management, or a related field with at least five years of experience in corporate physical security, including experience supporting or managing multi-site security operations.

Knowledge of CCure access control and Milestone video management systems.
Familiarity with security management reporting tools and KPI or dashboard-based reporting.
Understanding of physical security principles, risk-assessment methodologies, incident-response practices, and physical security technologies.
Knowledge of corporate security investigations, emergency management, business continuity, crisis management, or workplace incident-response programs.
Project-management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, priorities, and stakeholder expectations.
Effective communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
Analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the ability to interpret incident trends, operational metrics, system data, and risk information.
Able to interact effectively at all levels and across diverse cultures.
Able to manage multiple project s simultaneously with competing priorities and deadlines.
Attentive to detail and accuracy.
Computer skills; Microsoft Office.

Regular computer usage.
Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
Frequent sitting, standing, and/or walking.
Travel, as required.

new_jobs.title: Stage - Data Analyst (H/F)
new_jobs.description:
Safran.AI - De l'IA qui opère dans le réel

Filiale de Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran.AI conçoit des solutions d'IA appliquées à des données complexes telles que les images satellite haute résolution, les flux vidéo FMV et les signaux acoustiques. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des algorithmes capables de détecter et d'identifier automatiquement des objets d'intérêt dans les secteurs du renseignement, de la défense et de l'aéronautique.

Depuis son intégration à Safran en septembre 2024, Safran.AI contribue également à la transformation du groupe, en appliquant les solutions d’IA aux domaines de l’industrie 4.0. À titre d’exemple, l’analyse d’images automatisée par l’IA peut assister les contrôleurs en charge de l’inspection de pièces critiques en les aidant à détecter les anomalies éventuelles à partir de clichés numériques.

Fort de nos 250 collaborateurs, vous évoluerez au sein d’équipes passionnées et pluridisciplinaires, réunissant des talents parmi les plus reconnus du secteur, tous animés par une même exigence d’excellence et d’innovation technologique.

Brève introduction de l'équipe

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe AI Platform, qui développe une plateforme data (datalake, datawarehouse, orchestrateur de transformation de données, BI) et un ensemble d’outils internes de MLOps à destination des data scientists visant à accélérer le développement et la mise en production de modèles de machine/deep learning : l’AI Factory.

Toutes les étapes de développement sont couvertes : captation de la donnée, ingestion, transformation, modélisation et exposition. Nos enjeux sont nombreux pour stocker une grande quantité de données et l’exposer de la manière la plus efficace aux data scientists.

Nous sommes une quinzaine de collaborateurs au sein de l’équipe, avec des profils mixtes AI / Data Engineering / Software.

Descriptif des missions

En tant que Data Analyst en stage au sein de l’équipe AI Platform, vous contribuerez à développer les usages analytics de notre plateforme de données. En vous appuyant sur les briques existantes, notamment notre datalake et nos data warehouses, vous explorerez les données pour en tirer des enseignements utiles aux équipes et favoriser une prise de décision basée sur la donnée.

Avec l’accompagnement de l’équipe, vous travaillerez notamment à :

échanger avec les équipes AI Platform et les data scientists au sein des différents domaines d’application pour comprendre leurs besoins, identifier des cas d’usage et les traduire en questions d’analyse et en indicateurs pertinents
explorer les données disponibles dans le datalake, les data warehouses et les outils existants, afin d’en comprendre le contenu, la qualité et le potentiel pour les analyses identifiées
préparer, croiser et analyser ces données, notamment à l’aide de SQL et de Python, pour identifier des tendances, des points d’attention et des pistes d’amélioration
définir et construire des indicateurs et des tableaux de bord, par exemple avec Metabase, pour suivre les usages et les performances des produits de la plateforme
partager les résultats de vos analyses avec les équipes concernées, en expliquant leurs limites et en proposant des pistes d’action
contribuer à la fiabilité et à la réutilisation des analyses en documentant les sources, les définitions des indicateurs et les méthodes employées, en lien avec les data engineers

Notre stack technique

Nous utilisons essentiellement du Python orchestré avec Airflow, des bases de données PostgreSQL (extension PostGIS) ainsi que des services AWS (S3, EC2, RDS..). Nous manipulons des formes hétérogènes de données (rasters, vidéos, fichiers parquet, GeoJSON, …), exploitées à l’aide de notre datalake (utilisation d’Iceberg et de Kafka par exemple).

Nos applications data sont déployées sur un cluster Nomad (Hashicorp), avec une intégration et un déploiement continu depuis Github Actions.

Nos collègues SRE utilisent quant à eux principalement les technos Ansible, Terraform pour l’automatisation et la suite Prometheus / Grafana pour le monitoring. La plupart de nos applications sont déployées sur le cloud et on-premise.

Vous avez une première approche de la visualisation de données et de la construction d’indicateurs ou de tableaux de bord

Qualités humaines recherchées :

As a Top-10 ENR Contractor, Gilbane is a family-owned business with 45 offices that has been shaping communities since 1870. Consistently recognized as one of the most reputable construction management firms in the country, Gilbane is committed to delivering projects safely and on-time. You are a coach/leader who leads with an inclusive and empathetic mindset. You provide feedback and guidance to help others excel in their current or future roles. Gilbane offers employees multi-dimensional training opportunities through a number of resources. While managing your responsibilities to the project, you will be able to enroll in trainings through our award-winning Gilbane University to build leadership and technical skills. In addition, you will work with experienced Sr. Project Managers and Project Executives on each job site which provides you with opportunity to learn new industry skills every day. You will protect and promote the interests of both Gilbane and the client in all matters as well as demonstrating the personal characteristics of a developing leader.

Responsibilities

Assists in project controls and procedures, and manages established risk mitigation processes
Creates and follows through on potential change items and participates in verification of project financial forecast
Creates and manages a project-specific quality plan aligned with the owner contract and contract documents and assists with execution
Creates and manages a closeout plan in alignment with the contract documents and assist with execution

Aids in communicating company and department strategy to direct reports

Experience/Education

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management
4-7 years of experience
Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong technical and communication skills are critical
Ability to work in a team environment
Knowledge of industry standard software, Microsoft Office (preferred)

new_jobs.title: Finance Transformation Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About The Role

Atoms is building a Finance function where routine work runs on automation and AI, and Finance partners spend their time on judgment, forecasting, and advising the business. As the Finance Transformation Lead, you will turn that vision into a roadmap and then deliver it. You’ll work with Finance, Engineering, Data, and Internal Audit to redesign how we plan, transact, close, and report. You’ll also make sure every change holds up under audit scrutiny.

In the first 6 to 12 months, you’ll own the overall Finance Transformation roadmap, prioritization framework, and KPIs, and personally lead the redesign and automation of Procure-to-Pay, from requisition through payment. You’ll work closely with the Finance Systems and Data Engineering teams to translate process needs into technical requirements, and with other transformation leads to keep the portfolio coordinated. After that, you’ll extend your scope to partner with Strategic Finance on transforming planning, forecasting, and analysis. As the portfolio grows, you’ll help set the strategic direction for Finance Transformation across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Set the direction

Own the multi-year Finance Transformation roadmap with the VP, Finance Technology and Transformation. Tie it to Atoms’ growth plans and the Finance operating model.
Build and run the prioritization framework, business cases, and benefits tracking that decide what we fund. Maintain a single view of the portfolio across Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, and Strategic Finance, including dependencies and capacity.
Define and track program KPIs, such as close cycle time, touchless transaction rate, cost to serve, forecast accuracy, realized savings and capacity released, and stakeholder satisfaction. Report progress to Finance leadership regularly.

Lead Procure-to-Pay transformation

Take a first-principles approach to the end-to-end P2P process, including intake and requisition, sourcing, contracts, purchase orders, receiving, invoice processing, approvals, payment, and vendor management. Fix the process before automating it.
Lead selection and implementation of procurement and AP automation tools with Finance Systems, covering requirements, vendor assessment, build-versus-buy, and total cost of ownership.
Deliver automation in high-volume work such as invoice capture and coding, PO matching, exception handling, and accruals, and define the controls that go with it.

Partner with Strategic Finance (after the first 6 to 12 months)

Work with Strategic Finance and FP&A to redesign planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes, and the tools and data behind them.
Identify and deliver automation and AI use cases such as forecast support, variance commentary, and self-serve reporting, working with Finance Data Engineering and the Finance ML/AI team.
Help define the data and metrics foundations that Strategic Finance needs to scale.

Put AI to work, responsibly

Identify and ship practical AI use cases in Finance, including agentic workflows.
Decide, with process owners, which work belongs with people and which with AI.
Establish governance for AI in Finance: human-in-the-loop review, accountability, model validation, documentation, and audit readiness.

Project management and controls

Lead project management for cross-functional initiatives, including scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and change management.
Stay close enough to the work to review process designs, data models, and configurations yourself.
Work with Internal Audit and external auditors early, so controls are designed in and documented rather than added later.

Prepare The Team For What’s Next

Assess how Finance roles and skills will change with automation and AI, and help define new career paths and learning programs.
Lead change management: communication, training, adoption tracking, and feedback loops, so new tools and processes are actually used.
Guide and mentor Finance Transformation specialists and other team members on process, project, and portfolio practices.

What We're Looking For

10 years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting/Controllership, or FP&A, with at least 5 years in Finance Transformation.
Deep experience in Procure-to-Pay, and a record of delivering measurable results from ERP or procurement system implementations, process redesign, automation, or data modernization.
Experience building a transformation roadmap, prioritization framework, and benefits tracking for a portfolio of initiatives, and reporting on it to senior leaders.
Working knowledge of AI and automation tools, and sound judgment on when and how to apply them in a controlled environment.Strong understanding of controls and financial reporting requirements.
Familiarity with finance platforms such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Workday, Coupa, Anaplan, or similar, and with data tools such as SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or BI platforms.Experience leading without direct authority across Finance, Engineering, and Data, and managing external partners.
Clear executive communication, strong analytical skills, and comfort with ambiguity.
Nice to have: experience with FP&A or Strategic Finance processes and planning tools such as Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, or Pigment.

How You’ll Succeed Here

You question “how we’ve always done it” and back your view with data.
You get into the details of a process, a data set, or a system configuration when it matters.
You think about what’s best for Atoms, not for any one team.
You’re curious about new technology and disciplined about controls.
You build trust quickly and keep people moving in the same direction.

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

You will lead the end-to-end delivery of IT infrastructure programs for our commercial and workplace build-outs, from site planning through go-live.
