new_jobs.title: Strategy & Business Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

As a member of our Strategy & Business Operations team, you will lead planning and delivery of high priority projects. Projects include accelerating new offerings, identifying and fostering new partnerships, streamlining our operating rhythm, and fostering cross-functional collaboration. The team partners with business and product leaders to drive B-Stock’s strategy, identify opportunities for growth and investment, and drive innovation and best-in-class execution across teams. You'll also raise how the team works by applying AI to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis, building toward more automated approaches to recurring strategy and operations work over time. This person would report directly to the Vice President of Strategy & Business Operations.

B-Stock is an office-first company. You will be expected to work on-site three days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday at one of our office in Boston, MA, with Monday and Friday remaining non-office days where you may perform your duties remotely from your residence. We believe having consistent time together helps teams stay connected to the work happening across the business, collaborate in real time, and move ideas and decisions forward more effectively.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Drive end-to-end strategic projects to define and accelerate the company’s top growth priorities
Lead B-Stock’s foray into new segments, offerings, or partnerships leveraging the depth of B-Stock’s data, customer relationships, and network
Develop strategic frameworks to identify market growth opportunities for B-Stock
Help business leaders and executives make smart decisions and drive them to implementation by bringing data, analysis, and industry expertise to bear.
Identify and implement AI-enabled workflows and automations within Strategy & Business Operations to compress analysis cycles and scale the team's output
Design and run the operating cadence — planning cycles, business reviews, and cross-functional execution — turning strategy into delivered outcomes, not just recommendations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

5+ years in a strategy, consulting, finance, or business-operations role where you personally drove problems from hypothesis to delivered result
You're highly analytical and quantitatively fluent — you bring rigor to decisions and structure ambiguous problems, model in spreadsheets, pressure-test assumptions, and quantify the size of the prize.
You have a bias to impact — you've owned initiatives from strategy through execution and can point to outcomes you shipped
You communicate with clarity and influence — distilling complex analysis into simple, actionable recommendations that help executives make fast, confident decisions
Hands-on experience applying AI tools within analytical or operating workflows to build automations or multi-step processes, and comfort quickly adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge
You have a learning mindset and adapt quickly - we learn new things every day

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Two-sided marketplace, Retail, Logistics and/or Supply Chain experience
Interest in or exposure to reverse logistics, returns, or the circular economy
Experience taking a new product, segment, or initiative from 0-to-1
MBA or advanced degree from a top program, or equivalent experience

The pay rate for this role will range between $110,000 to $150,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options
Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K)
Support for continuing education
Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple
Snacks, drinks, and the occasional box of donuts

THE COMPANY

B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. With hundreds of thousands transactions completed annually, B-Stock gives buyers a simple and direct way to buy valuable products directly from retailers and offers sellers a technology-driven replacement for traditional resale methods, while boosting operational efficiency, recovery rates, and cycle time.

Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come.

For more information, visit bstock.com/careers/

OUR VALUES

Make Each Dollar Count

Whether it’s the recovery amount or a buyer’s budget, money matters to all of our clients. And because each dollar matters to them, it matters to us.

Take Our Work Seriously, Not Ourselves

Everything at B-Stock continues to grow - everything but our egos, that is. We’re not afraid to let loose and laugh (often at ourselves).

Do The Hard Things Today That Will Pay Off Tomorrow

We’re willing to sacrifice and endure, fail and adapt to reach our long-term goals.

Use Trust As The Best Measure Of Success

The trust we earn along the way is more valuable than money. Without trust from both our buyers and sellers, our business won’t succeed.

Find Strength In Numbers

Use our passion for data to provide value to our customers, improve ourselves, and develop new ways to delight our buyers and sellers.

No applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” B-Stock also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at B-Stock.

Experience managing third-party system integrators, SAP Services, and other external service providers during project implementation.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Implementation Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Checkr

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About The Team/role

As a Customer Success Implementation Manager reporting to the Director of Implementations, you will drive successful deployments for Checkr’s most important customers and partners. You will contribute to the day-to-day project management of multiple deployments at once, keeping scope, timelines, and quality on track. You will partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architects, Product, Support, and Customer Success Managers to deliver a white-glove onboarding experience that supports Checkr’s growth.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain project plans and RAID logs from templates, and lead regular check-in meetings with customers and partners
Identify project risks early and coordinate with the right teams to mitigate and resolve them
Track and report deployment progress to management using reporting tools and dashboards
Manage dependencies across GTM, Product, and Operations for multiple concurrent projects
Prepare and coordinate customer training, helping customers and partners understand product features and benefits
Translate complex project information for audiences ranging from project-level contributors to executives, and hand off customers smoothly to Customer Success Managers after go-live
Serve as a go-to subject matter expert on product functionality
Collaborate as a team player, sharing knowledge and supporting teammates

What You Bring

3+ years of project management experience in a related industry or SaaS
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, and comfort communicating from executives to analysts
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence collaborative decision-making
Technical understanding of software systems at scale, including high-level knowledge of APIs
Flexibility to manage multiple priorities and projects, internal and external, in a fast-paced environment
An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes

Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website .

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)

$151,000—$178,000 USD

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (Denver, CO)

$128,000—$151,000 USD

What We Offer

A fast-paced and collaborative environment
Learning and development allowance
Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services
Flexible PTO policy
Monthly wellness stipend

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr

Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance .

Applicant Privacy Policy

If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process.

For applicants in Massachusetts:
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Legitimate Checkr emails will always include our official domain name after the @ symbol (e.g., name@checkr.com or name@ext.checkr.com).

new_jobs.title: Security Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Park Nicollet is hiring a Security Manager at Methodist Hospital. The Security Manager plans and directs the business unit security function under senior management direction. Accountable for ensuring that the security programs and strategies of the organization are effectively implemented and maintained. Manages the security operations, overall planning, directing, and organizing programs of one or more major sites/facilities within a geographic region. Implements the policies, procedures and systems required for maintaining and enhancing the overall organization's security mission.

Plans, organizes, and directs the activities of Security Supervisors and ensures their actions comply with legal, regulatory requirements, and customer needs. Plans and manages the most sensitive and complex security functions and develops, coordinates, and finalizes security and technical support efforts. Develops and implements policies, procedures, standards, training, and methods for identifying and protecting information, personnel, property, facilities, operations, or material from unauthorized disclosure, misuse, theft, assault, vandalism, product tampering, espionage, sabotage, or loss.

Through consultation with Security Director and Supervisors, establishes long and short-term security operations objectives for the organization. Plans, develops, and implements procedures to obtain, maintain, secure, analyze, account for, and provide information from assessment reports. Directs the initiation of proactive facility assessments and surveys. Based on results of trends and survey results, recommends corrective measures.

Plans, acquires, and administers resources for the function, to include funding, equipment, and other resources. Develops and documents standards for measuring the efficiency and effectiveness of security operations. Serves on senior level intra and inter-corporate committees and working group. Manages the activities and provides leadership direction to the professional, technical and support staff within the organization unit. Performs other duties as assigned.

Responsible for all aspects of leading and managing personnel resources necessary to protect the facility including hiring, scheduling, equipping, training, directing, and discipline when appropriate. Ensures resources such as personal protection equipment, uniforms, vehicles, and communications needed to safely protect the organization are readily available and consistent with system-wide standards.

Minimum Qualifications

Education, Experience or Equivalent Combination:
Master’s degree and 8 years relevant experience, bachelor’s degree and approximately 10 years relevant experience or 15 years relevant experience, with at least 8 years in a management role and Healthcare Security and/or Corporate Security experience.

Licensure/ Registration/ Certification:
Must have a valid driver’s license (Class C) and meet the insurability requirements relating to Park Nicollet’s motor vehicle violation criteria.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Ability to manage personnel.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to develop goals and direct departmental activities.
Knowledge of legal and civil standards and requirements within the state of Minnesota regarding security and general law enforcement.
Ability to respond to and, if necessary, physically intervene in disruptive or dangerous situation to protect staff, patients, and others from harm.
Ability to develop and maintain relationships with hospital departments and other managers.
Ability to develop and maintain working relationships with agencies such as local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies and public safety agencies.
Ability to problem solve and make critical decisions quickly and effectively.
Ability to train personnel and conduct threat assessments.
Proven proficiency in case management systems, access control and video surveillance as well as computer word processing programs & Microsoft office programs.
Utilization of telephones, pagers and 2-way phone/radios for communications.

Preferred Qualifications

Education, Experience or Equivalent Combination:
Previous management and leadership experience with a major law enforcement, intelligence, public service or private sector security organization at a manager, director, or command officer level.

Licensure/ Registration/ Certification:
International Association for Healthcare Security & Safety (IAHSS) certification, Certified Healthcare Safety Professional (CHSP) designation, Certified Protection Professional (CPP) or similar certification.
HSEM/FEMA Certificates in the following NIMS training completed within 1 year of hire: ICS-100, 200, 700, 800.

Essential Duties

(50%) – Manages the organizations security program and directs day to day operations to maintain a secure environment.

Provides counsel and direction to staff on a regular basis to provide work direction and assist with problem solving.
Performs and oversees the execution of threat assessments on those events that present known and unknown threats.
Supervises staff to include hiring, coaching, educating, evaluating and performance management.
Assists with establishing and maintaining an annual budget that supports the costs associated with staffing, training, maintenance of equipment and education.
Operates within the approved budget and communicates directly to the Director of Security when conditions warrant otherwise.
Appropriately plans for capital expenditures that support existing and new programs that provide security to the organization.
Responsible for implementing and managing site specific training for security supervisors and officers, and other related training that is necessary through new programs, processes and systems that are introduced into the operation.
(25%) – Evaluates the effectiveness of the security program continually to identify gaps and vulnerabilities.
Performs annual surveys of the facilities to evaluate the effectiveness of the security program, potential breaches, and general opportunities for improvement.
Develops quality assurance measures that will ensure that all policies and procedures are being followed by the officers.
Develops supervisor staff to ensure expectations are being established with staff and that supervisors are being held accountable for their shifts and their staff.
Performs improvement work related to current or new work standards.
(20%) – Collaboration with internal partners.
Represents the Security department in development or update of internal processes.
(5%) – Coordinates interactions with local/county/federal law enforcement partners when events are reported to their respective agencies.
Serves as a contact for all law enforcement agencies.
Coordinates the hospital efforts with Secret Service and other VIP related activities when necessary.
Partners with law enforcement to follow-up when criminal complaints have been filed on behalf of the organization.
(Ongoing) – Performs other duties as assigned.

About Us

At HealthPartners we believe in the power of good – good deeds and good people working together. As part of our team, you’ll find an inclusive environment that encourages new ways of thinking, celebrates differences, and recognizes hard work.

We’re a nonprofit, integrated health care organization, providing health insurance in six states and high-quality care at more than 90 locations, including hospitals and clinics in Minnesota and Wisconsin. We bring together research and education through HealthPartners Institute, training medical professionals across the region and conducting innovative research that improve lives around the world.

At HealthPartners, everyone is welcome, included and valued. We’re working together to increase diversity and inclusion in our workplace, advance health equity in care and coverage, and partner with the community as advocates for change.

Benefits Designed To Support Your Total Health

As a HealthPartners colleague, we’re committed to nurturing your diverse talents, valuing your dedication, and supporting your work-life balance. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits to support every aspect of your life, including health, time off, retirement planning, and continuous learning opportunities. Our goal is to help you thrive physically, mentally, emotionally, and financially, so you can continue delivering exceptional care.

Join us in our mission to improve the health and well-being of our patients, members, and communities.

new_jobs.title: Cyber All-Source Intelligence Analyst, Senior
new_jobs.description:
Job Number: R0254290

Cyber All-Source Intelligence Analyst, Senior

The Opportunity:

Our clients need skilled analysts to turn reams of data into actionable intelligence for our government and military every day. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, are familiar with foreign military and related political issues and intelligence tradecraft standards and are ready to help our nation's leaders understand the critical threats and opportunities facing our country, we have an opportunity for you. Join our team as a Cyber All-Source Intelligence Analyst.

In this role, you’ll review reporting from classified and unclassified intelligence streams every day as you build assessments that reflect the priorities of your regional or topical portfolios. You'll develop specific products by requesting and proposing your own, coordinating with analysts on our team and across the intelligence community (IC), and briefing warfighters, senior policymakers, and IC members on our analytic lines. Thanks to our mentoring and training resources, you'll also be able to hone your skills and mature into a stronger analyst. Our world is shifting quickly, and our clients need analysts who can help them stay several steps ahead.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

Experience with all-source Military Capability (MILCAP) analysis and production covering foreign cyber actors' intent, tactics, and vulnerabilities
Experience with adversarial cyber operations and the infrastructure supporting these services
Experience applying cyber threat intelligence frameworks to intelligence reports and briefings
Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK
Knowledge of cyber topics, including authentication threats, AI, telecommunication infrastructure, and cloud networks
Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings
Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
HS diploma or GED and 7+ years of experience with analysis, or Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience with analysis

Nice If You Have:

Experience authoring current DoD product lines and utilizing ICD 203 tradecraft standards
Knowledge of the intelligence cycle
Knowledge of the EUCOM AOR
Cyber Certifications, including SEC+, CEH, or CySA+ Certification

Clearance: 

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your
own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided
.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

Read and interpret PowerShell and Python scripts, and apply scripting and automation to streamline investigation, enrichment, and reporting workflows.

Initially managing a small group of inspection and technical professionals, you will help identify future staffing needs, recruit and develop additional talent, and build the capabilities necessary to support anticipated business growth. You will engage with TxDOT and other state DOTs, municipalities, and transportation clients, serving as a technical resource while identifying opportunities to strengthen existing relationships and develop new business. This may include partnering with other engineering consultancies, supporting strategic pursuits, participating in marketing initiatives, and representing AECOM at industry conferences, trade shows, and professional events.

This is an opportunity for a technically accomplished bridge inspection professional who enjoys being involved in the field, developing people, building client relationships, and helping grow a business. You will have the support and resources of AECOM's established transportation and construction management organization while helping shape the future direction of its bridge inspection capabilities across the region.

Manage and support routine and complex NBIS bridge inspection programs as opportunities develop, ensuring inspections are performed in accordance with applicable federal requirements, state DOT standards, and client expectations.
Provide technical leadership for specialized inspection opportunities, potentially including fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, underwater bridge inspections, tunnel inspections, and other complex structural assessments.
Plan and coordinate potential underwater bridge inspection assignments, including overseeing inspection divers, developing inspection plans, coordinating field resources, and ensuring appropriate safety procedures and technical requirements are followed.
Provide technical oversight of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods and specialized inspection procedures used to evaluate structural conditions, identify deterioration, and assess the integrity of bridge components.
Support bridge condition assessments and preservation efforts, evaluating inspection findings, identifying critical deficiencies, managing Follow-Up Actions (FUAs), and developing recommendations for maintenance, rehabilitation, and repair.
Manage project budgets, schedules, staffing, subcontractors, deliverables, and quality control activities for awarded bridge inspection and assessment projects.
Serve as a primary client contact as projects develop, building relationships with TxDOT, other state DOTs, municipalities, and transportation agencies while communicating technical findings, project progress, and recommended solutions.
Review and oversee the preparation of bridge inspection reports, condition assessments, technical evaluations, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable NBIS and agency requirements.
Initially manage a small team of bridge inspection professionals, with the opportunity to recruit, develop, and expand the team as business needs and project opportunities increase.
Identify and pursue opportunities to expand AECOM's bridge inspection services through client engagement, relationship development, strategic marketing, and participation in transportation infrastructure pursuits.
Develop teaming relationships and partner with other engineering consultancies and industry firms to pursue potential inspection and preservation opportunities and strengthen AECOM's position in the regional bridge inspection market.
Represent AECOM at industry conferences, technical meetings, trade shows, and professional association events, helping promote the firm's bridge inspection capabilities and develop new client relationships.
Maintain a strong commitment to safety, ensuring field personnel follow established safety protocols, applicable OSHA standards, proper equipment setup procedures, and safe working practices during inspection activities.
Travel throughout Texas and surrounding states to support inspection programs, client meetings, business development activities, and project assignments, including overnight travel as opportunities require.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

BA/BS + 8 YORE or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy.
Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of Texas or the ability to obtain Texas PE licensure through reciprocity.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience managing routine and complex NBIS bridge inspection programs, including hands-on experience with fracture-critical and Nonredundant Steel Tension Member (NSTM) inspections, procedures, and specialized structural assessments.
TxDOT Precertification 6.1.1 – Bridge Inspection Team Leader, along with completion of the NHI Safety Inspection of In-Service Bridges national training course.
Additional TxDOT pre-certifications, including 6.1.2, 6.2.1, 6.2.2, 6.3.1, 6.3.2, 6.4.1, 6.5.1, 6.5.2, 6.6.1, and 6.6.2.
Experience with underwater bridge inspection programs, including planning inspection operations, overseeing inspection divers, coordinating specialized equipment, and ensuring compliance with applicable safety and inspection requirements. Demonstrated experience with tunnel inspections, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) methods, bridge condition assessments, and preservation programs, including identifying deterioration, managing critical findings and Follow-Up Actions (FUAs), and recommending appropriate repair and rehabilitation strategies.
Experience working directly with TxDOT and other state DOTs, transportation agencies, and municipal clients, with the ability to develop client relationships, communicate complex technical findings, and support the development of long-term inspection programs.

The SCRM Analyst is responsible for assessing supply chain threats and vulnerabilities across hardware, software, services, and vendors, and for driving technical and process controls that reduce risk.

Evaluate government contractors and suppliers for security vulnerabilities, financial stability, and compliance with national security standards.

Experience using GRC tools (e.g., JCAM, eMASS) to track security documentation and compliance activities.

Qualifications

To qualify for a Program Analyst, your resume and supporting documentation must support:

Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position and is directly in or related to this position. To qualify at the GS14 level, applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-13 level or equivalent under other pay systems in the Federal service, military, or private sector. Applicants must meet eligibility requirements including time-in-grade (General Schedule (GS) positions only), time-after-competitive appointment, minimum qualifications, and any other regulatory requirements by the cut-off/closing date of the announcement. Creditable specialized experience includes:
Experience leading the development and integration of Federal Mission Resilience, continuity, and crisis management policies and strategic plans to ensure mission readiness and organizational continuity during all-hazards events.
Experience providing strategic analysis and expert advisory support to executive-level leaders through the preparation and presentation of complex policy recommendations, briefing materials, and decision-support products.
Experience coordinating and representing organizational interests in interagency, joint, and senior-level forums to address resilience, continuity, emergency management, and national security initiatives.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Drug-Free Workplace Policy

The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is committed to maintaining a safe, drug-free workplace. All DLA employees are required to refrain from illegal drug use on and off duty. DLA conducts pre-employment, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, and random drug testing.

Applicants tentatively selected for employment in testing designated positions will undergo a urinalysis to screen for illegal drug use prior to appointment. Refusal to undergo testing or testing positive for illegal drugs will result in withdrawal of the tentative job offer and a six-month denial of employment with DLA from the date of the drug test. Employees in drug testing designated positions are subject to random drug testing. A negative drug test result must be received by HR within 30 calendar days after the EOD (i.e., start date). The selectee's inability successfully pass; or refusal to conduct the test may result in: 1) the tentative or FJO being withdrawn during the recruitment process; or 2) subsequently being removed from Federal service for failure to meet a condition of employment. You may be required to sign a "Drug Test Statement of Understanding" if you are selected for this position.

The DLA drug testing panel tests for the following substances: marijuana, cocaine, opiates, heroin, phencyclidine, amphetamines, methamphetamines, fentanyl, norfentanyl, methylenedioxymethamphetamine (MDMA), methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA), and opioids.

ADVISORY: Use of cannabidiol (CBD) products may result in a positive drug test for marijuana. DLA employees are subject to Federal law and under Federal law, Marijuana is illegal
